Hotel Tagline: A private bay catches the last light on that gold façade, something no photograph holds.
Summary: We keep coming back for the private bay at dusk — the light on that façade does something the photographs never quite capture. Book a sea-view room and you'll understand why this address has defined Abu Dhabi's waterfront for twenty years.
Description ⚙: The Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, Abu Dhabi, gives its guests precisely what it says on the tin. From jaw-dropping views over its private natural bay flowing along the pristine waters of the Arabian Gulf and Marina to five-star luxuries for royals. Adorned with crystal mosaics, silver, and gold, this hotel's Arabian paradise will make its guests feel like they’re living in the setting of the 1001 Arabian Nights. Each room is decadently decorated to the finest finishings, holding to this Abu Dhabi hotel’s rich history.
Address: West Corniche Road - Al Ras Al Akhdar - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates
Nearest Airports: AZI · Al Bateen Executive · 21 km; AUH · Abu Dhabi International · 37 km

Hotel Tagline: Suspended between the Nation Towers, with the Corniche, marina, and Grand Mosque spread below.
Summary: The bridge suite between the Nation Towers is one of those rooms worth building a trip around — 360° of Gulf and city, suspended in mid-air. Even a standard Corniche room earns its rate. Azura at the top is where we'd start the evening.
Description ⚙: Situated in the sleek, sky-reaching Nation Towers complex, The St. Regis Abu Dhabi views over Abu Dhabi’s vibrant Corniche, Marina Mall, World Trade Center Mall, and Sheikh Zayed's iconic Mosque (all within nearby distance) are enough to leave you gasping for air. Nowhere is this more true than at the hotel’s rooftop bar, the Azura Panoramic Lounge, as the sun sets over the stunning Abu Dhabi Skyline.
View Subjects: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, The Corniche

Hotel Tagline: From the water's edge, the domes of Qasr Al Watan sit just far enough away to read as a view.
Summary: From the water's edge here, the domes of Qasr Al Watan sit just far enough away to read as a view rather than a neighbour. The private beach is quieter than Saadiyat — which, depending on what you're after, is exactly the point.
Description ⚙: The Khalidiya Palace Rayhaan by Rotana, Abu Dhabi, prides itself on being one of the top-located hotels in Abu Dhabi, featuring views across the turquoise waters of the Arabian Gulf, the hotel’s private beach, and the distinct Qasr Al Watan, the presidential palace. The hotel’s interiors blend traditional Arabian and elegant contemporary styles. Tantalize your taste buds with the delectable meals at the hotel’s in-house eateries: Kamoon (offering pure Arabic gastronomy); and The Lounge (found in the hotel lobby). Days at this luxury Abu Dhabi hotel typically include relaxing by the pool, taking a much-needed massage at the Wellness and Massage spa, or exploring the Abu Dhabi attractions: Abu Dhabi Exhibition Center, Emirates Palace, and The Landmark Tower. We recommend heading to the in-house Sunset Bar for a late-night drink to enjoy the stunning views over the gulf.
Address: Corniche St - Al Khubeirah - W32 - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates
Nearest Airports: AZI · Al Bateen Executive · 21 km; AUH · Abu Dhabi International · 37 km

Hotel Tagline: Across the creek from the Al Hanah terrace, the Grand Mosque glows at dusk.
Summary: There's a specific moment at the Al Hanah terrace — the call to prayer, the Grand Mosque illuminated across the water — that stays with you. We'd choose a room facing the creek over almost anything else in the city. This is the one Abu Dhabi address we always mention first.
Description ⚙: Situated on a pristine private beach, visitors of the Shangri-La Hotel, Qaryat Al Beri, Abu Dhabi, can experience uninterrupted panoramic views, including the Khor Al Maqta waterfront area and the hotel’s perfectly landscaped gardens from selected rooms. To take in the incredible scenery across the Arabian Gulf from up close, guests can go aboard one of the hotel’s luxury gondola rides. Additionally, guests will swoon at the abundance of spa treatments in the Shangri-La Hotel, Qaryat Al Beri, Abu Dhabi. The two outdoor pools, sophisticated architectural & interior designs, and distinctive touch of elegance put this five-star Abu Dhabi hotel in a league of its own. Foodies will ravish the selection of authentic Chinese (Shang Palace) and French (Bord Eau) cuisines on the menu.
Address: Khor Al Maqta,Qaryat al Beri - Rabdan - RB2 - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates

Summary: The Eclipse Terrace at sunset earns its reputation — Gulf light, city skyline behind you, and service that reads the room without being asked. We'd request a high floor facing west and stay through dinner. The position at the tip of Al Maryah is genuinely difficult to beat.
Description ⚙: Offering endless views over the glistening waters of the Arabian Gulf and twinkling lights of the ever-expanding Abu Dhabi skyline, the five-star Four Seasons Hotel Abu Dhabi at Al Maryah Island sets itself apart as one of the top-voted hotels to stay at in Abu Dhabi. A relaxing atmosphere lingers here, and guests can enjoy luxurious treatments at the in-house spa, lounge at the pool, or grab a drink on the luxe rooftop terrace while taking in the panoramic views.

Hotel Tagline: From Al Maryah Island's edge, the Arabian Gulf shifts from pale blue at dawn to gold by sunset.
Summary: Glo is where we'd tell a friend to go for a first evening in Abu Dhabi — the Gulf from Al Maryah's edge at last light is that kind of view. The rooms facing the water shift from pale blue at dawn to something close to gold by the time the sun drops.
Description ⚙: Dripping with luxurious, contemporary design and decor, the Rosewood Abu Dhabi is situated along the highly sought-after Arabian Gulf (which can be viewed from most rooms) on Al Maryah Island - the very heart of the new Abu Dhabi Financial Center. Here, guests can take part in extreme workouts at the in-house gym and relax at The Sense Spa afterward for some much-deserved downtime; or take a dip in the refreshing pool. Few do it better than Rosewood Abu Dhabi regarding meal times. Featuring a staggering eight restaurants in its midst, guests have a fantastic selection of cuisines from all across the world. For those stretching the clock, the fun continues at the La Cava, Glo, or Hidden Bar, where cocktails are a must-try.
Address: Zayed the First Street - Al Maryah Island - MI1 - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates
Nearest Airports: AZI · Al Bateen Executive · 14 km; AUH · Abu Dhabi International · 35 km

Summary: We'd take a balcony room here over a higher floor anywhere else on this list. Al Bateen marina at night — yachts, city light on the water, the quiet movement of it all — is the kind of view you don't close the curtains on. The Annex rooftop is the right way to end the day.
Description ⚙: Planted in the yacht-filled Al Bateen Marina, The Abu Dhabi EDITION boutique hotel, guests will find a five-star gem that features elegant suites with scenic views over the Marina and Abu Dhabi Skyline from their balconies. Marble bathrooms, luxurious, contemporary finishes, and world-class services await all who check in to The Abu Dhabi EDITION.

Hotel Tagline: From the Observation Deck at 300, the whole coastline unfolds at once.
Summary: The Observation Deck at 300 settles the question of Abu Dhabi's scale — you see the whole coastline at once, and it stays with you. The rooms below deliver a version of that same view with a bed in front of it. For sheer vertical drama, nothing else in the city comes close.
Description ⚙: Consisting of five luxuriously sculpted towers overlooking the stunning Arabian Gulf and glittering Abu Dhabi skyline, the Conrad Abu Dhabi Etihad Towers sets a precedent for what a lavish, five-star hotel in the UAE should be. Offering services such as spa treatments in its world-class Talise Spa, delectable dining at Rosewater (for the best hotel buffet breakfasts) along with several other eateries, and complimentary access to the iconic Observation Deck at 300 - guests will feel taken care of in these immaculate serviced apartments & suites.

Hotel Tagline: White sand and the Arabian Gulf to the horizon, with the desert at the doorstep.
Summary: Saadiyat at its best — white sand, the Gulf to the horizon, and none of the urban density that follows you elsewhere. We'd book a villa, spend the morning at the infinity pool before the heat arrives, and make the ten-minute walk to the Louvre before dusk. The sequence works.
Description ⚙: When stepping into the Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel and Villas beach resort, guests receive world-class, five-star luxuries and treatments. At the same time, they step into a world of duality. We care to explain: there is a contrast between the glorious shores of Saadiyat in the hotel’s backyard and the golden sands of the Arabian desert on the doorstep. Doing a marvelous job of combining tradition with new-age culture, the Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel and Villas emulate a desert island sanctuary filled with total peace and relaxation. The 306 luxurious rooms, suites, and villas feature splendid views across the Arabian Gulf, pristine gardens, and infinity pools.
Address: Al Saadiyat Island - SDN1 - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates
Nearest Airports: AZI · Al Bateen Executive · 24 km; AUH · Abu Dhabi International · 32 km

Hotel Tagline: Open Gulf stretches to the horizon with nothing between you and it.
Summary: The ocean-view suites here face open Gulf with nothing between you and the horizon — and the Louvre Abu Dhabi is ten minutes on foot, which makes for an unexpectedly good afternoon. We'd pair a beach morning with the collection and call it a near-perfect day.
Description ⚙: An understated luxury lingers at the Jumeirah at Saadiyat Island Resort. It caters to everyone: from couples looking for a romantic retreat to families wanting to experience an unforgettable Abu Dhabi holiday together or luxury travelers searching for the next five-star escape. From modernly decorated suites featuring panoramic ocean views over the Arabian Gulf and a 400-meter natural beach to villas with private pools and complementary services, guests staying at this Saadiyat Island Resort Hotel will see their expectations surpassed. The top-notch beachfront hotel has seven unique restaurant and bar experiences, three spectacular pools to splash around in, and a spa that allows guests to disconnect for a few hours.
Address: Al Saadiyat Island - SDN3 - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates

We'd use this as a base for exploring the city and return each evening to that view. Quieter than the Corniche properties, and better value for it.
Description ⚙: Welcome to the Grand Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel & Residences Emirates Pearl, consistently ranked as one of the top hotels in Abu Dhabi. When enjoying the soaring views over the Arabian Gulf, West Corniche neighborhood, the Abu Dhabi Skyline, and Emirates Palace, guests feel as if they have completely stepped into the heart of Abu Dhabi. Here, one finds plenty of designer shopping experiences and trendy eateries surrounding the hotel - in the bustle of the Abu Dhabi Business District. The hotel features a 24-hour Wellness & Fitness club, a spectacular infinity pool overlooking the Arabian Gulf, a small private beach, and world-class dining & nightlife experience.

Hotel Tagline: Yachts at anchor in Al Bateen Marina, the Abu Dhabi skyline rising behind them.
Summary: The marina view from the rooms here does what a good view should — it gives you something to watch. Yachts come and go, the city skyline sits behind them, and the window becomes the room's focal point without trying. A considered choice at a price that leaves room for the rest of the trip.
Description ⚙: Situated on the highly sought-after Al Bateen Marina, the Royal M Hotel & Resort Abu Dhabi will win visitors over with its distinguished services and luxuries. When choosing this as their temporary address in Abu Dhabi, guests can enjoy spectacular views of the Al Bateen Marina and the Abu Dhabi skyline from selected rooms, suites & villas, all adorned in an unprecedented contemporary chicness. Book some relaxing treatments at the bespoke in-house spa, dip in the irresistible infinity pool, or have a romantic sunset dinner on the beach. Without ever needing to leave the hotel premises, guests are invited to an abundance of gourmet dining experiences under one roof, from feasting at the decadent Mezze Dining Room, splashing out at the Celebrity Restaurant, to living it up on the beachfront Marina Bar and feeling suave at the Cuvee Bar.

Hotel Tagline: Perched above rocky Atlantic cliffs, the restaurant looks out over Martinhal Beach and the islands beyond.
Summary: Direct access to Martinhal Beach, with the restaurant on a rise above the rocky Atlantic cliffs of Sagres — a different coastal texture from the sandy beaches further east. We’d book this for the family infrastructure, direct surf access, and proximity to Sagres Fortress.
Description ⚙: Designed with families in mind, the five-star Martinhal Sagres Beach Family Resort Hotel offers a haven where parents can truly relax while their children are entertained. Founded by Chitra and Roman Stern, the resort embodies their vision of allowing parents to enjoy a cappuccino with the foam still intact. Guests can embark on kayak trips to the nearby Martinhal islands just in front of the hotel. The restaurant, perched in an elevated position, offers glorious sea views that showcase the stunning rocky cliffs synonymous with Sagres. With direct access to Martinhal Beach, guests can quickly explore the Atlantic. History enthusiasts can also visit the historic Sagres Fortress and the town's rich association with the Portuguese Discoveries era.
Address: R. Baiona la Real Apartado 54, 8650-908 Sagres, Portugal

Hotel Tagline: Clifftop gardens fall away to nothing but Atlantic from every private terrace.
Summary: Fifty-four acres of subtropical gardens on a cliff above the Atlantic, with every room and suite carrying its own sea-view terrace. Request a clifftop villa for an infinity pool over the water. Two Michelin stars at Ocean Restaurant make a dinner reservation the other essential booking.
Description ⚙: Set on 54 acres of subtropical gardens above the Atlantic in Porches, Vila Vita Parc is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World and one of Portugal's most comprehensive five-star resorts. Every room and suite carries a private terrace facing the sea or the gardens; clifftop villas feature private infinity pools. Ocean Restaurant, helmed by Chef Hans Neuner, holds two Michelin stars. The Sisley Paris spa is the first of its kind in Portugal. A private beach, Praia dos Tremoços, is directly accessible from the resort, and the Armação Beach Club is a short shuttle ride away.
Address: R. Anneliese Pohl, Alporchinhos, 8400-450 Porches, Portugal
Nearest Airports: FAO · Faro · 57 km

Hotel Tagline: Cliffside above Praia da Galé, every room facing southwest into the Atlantic sunset.
Summary: Thirteen rooms in a Moorish cliffside villa above Praia da Galé — every one faces southwest for the sunset. Chef Dieter Koschina’s two-Michelin-star restaurant has held its distinction since 1995. Suite Joia’s two sea-view terraces, one with a Jacuzzi, are the rooms worth staying for.
Description ⚙: Perched above the golden sands of Praia da Galé west of Albufeira, Vila Joya is a Moorish-style villa with 13 rooms and suites — all facing southwest, guaranteeing an Atlantic view and a sunset from every accommodation. The two-Michelin-star restaurant, helmed by Austrian chef Dieter Koschina and holding its distinction since 1995, anchors the experience; the tasting menu changes daily and is paired from a wine cellar of 12,000 bottles. Suite Joia features two sea-view terraces, one with a Jacuzzi. The Royal Suite Alegria spans 140 sq m with a private garden and heated plunge pool. The spa includes a rooftop sauna, floating room, and Turkish bath. Open March to November.
Address: Estrada da Galé, 8200-416 Albufeira, Portugal
Nearest Airports: FAO · Faro · 53 km

Description ⚙: Planted in the prestigious Herdade dos Salgados in Albufeira, the five-star The Westin Salgados Beach Resort, Algarve presents a haven of luxury and tranquility. The hotel offers a direct pathway over the dunes to Salgados Beach. The Junior Suite with Sea View features a balcony with vistas of the gardens, pool, and Atlantic Ocean. Six outdoor pools serve different moods during the day. Salgados Golf, one of the finest 18-hole golf courses in Southern Europe, is a five-minute walk from the hotel. The Rooftop Salgados Lounge @14 offers panoramic views of the surrounding coast.

Summary: Positioned beside a nature reserve in the exclusive Herdade dos Salgados, VidaMar is a serious oceanfront address. The Club Rooms & Suites come with expansive balconies facing open water and exclusive access to MarClub, the adults-only area. The Ocean Restaurant breakfast frames the Atlantic.
Description ⚙: Situated in the exclusive Herdade dos Salgados, VidaMar Resort Hotel Algarve stands as a five-star oceanfront retreat next to a biodiverse nature reserve. The Club Rooms and Suites feature expansive balconies with unobstructed Atlantic Ocean views and exclusive access to MarClub, a premium adults-only area. The Ocean Restaurant serves breakfast with breathtaking ocean views. The spa circuit includes a pool, jacuzzi, sauna, Turkish bath, ice fountain, and cold-water bath.

Nearest Airports: FAO · Faro · 54 km

Description ⚙: Next to São Rafael Beach, renowned for its rugged beauty and secluded character, Kimpton Atlantico Algarve provides a five-star retreat with a direct wooden pathway connecting the hotel to the golden sands. Every room and suite features a balcony, offering views of the gardens or the sea cliffs and waves of São Rafael Beach. The hotel provides two indoor pools, three circular outdoor pools, and a well-equipped gym. The Arabian Sea Bar is positioned to witness glorious sunsets over the Atlantic.

All 134 rooms and suites face west to capture the Atlantic sunsets. The duplex WOW suites feature rooftop infinity pools with panoramic ocean views. The WET Deck infinity pool provides an elevated ocean position. Paper Moon Italian restaurant, originating in Milan, serves on a terrace facing the Atlantic. The fitness centre combines outdoor and indoor spaces with Technogym equipment.

Description ⚙: Situated adjacent to Falésia Beach — ranked the world's best beach by TripAdvisor in 2024 — EPIC SANA Algarve Hotel offers an idyllic seaside retreat in a pinewood setting. The 4th-floor rooms with balconies deliver sea views framed by the surrounding pine forest, a distinctive combination unique to this property. A suspended wooden bridge connects the hotel to Falésia Beach. The Al Quimia fine dining restaurant holds a consistent reputation as one of the Algarve's best culinary experiences. Three outdoor adult pools, two outdoor kids pools, and an indoor pool complete the amenities.

Summary: Set on ochre cliffs above Falésia Beach, Pine Cliffs spans 72 hectares with every ocean-view room positioned to face the Atlantic from height. The cliff-edge Mirador Champagne Bar is the unhurried spot at the end of any day. Maré at beach level handles lunch with the waves arriving close.
Description ⚙: Set on ochre cliffs above Falésia Beach, Pine Cliffs Hotel spans 72 hectares of resort grounds with every ocean-view room positioned to face the Atlantic. A Luxury Collection Resort since its inception in 1992, the hotel underwent an extensive renovation overseen by London-based designer Lynne Hunt, reopening in 2016. The resort includes a scenic 9-hole golf course where the Devil's Parlour hole carries 197 metres over the cliffs. Maré restaurant sits at beach level, serving seafood on a wooden deck directly above the sand. The Mirador Champagne Bar occupies the clifftop with unobstructed Atlantic panoramas. The Serenity Spa and Porto Pirata, one of the region's largest kids clubs, are on site.

Description ⚙: The Algarve's first hotel, built in 1918, the Bela Vista Hotel & Spa occupies a Moorish-style mansion above Praia da Rocha in Portimão. A Relais & Châteaux member since 2013, the property holds 38 individually decorated rooms and suites across three distinct houses. Most rooms feature Atlantic Ocean views from private balconies; the Palace building rooms are adorned with hand-painted Portuguese tiles. Vista Restaurant holds a Michelin star and serves on a west-facing terrace directly above the beach. The spa is operated with L'Occitane products. Adults-only throughout the season; open mid-February to late November.
Address: Av. Tomás Cabreira, 8500-802 Portimão, Portugal
Nearest Airports: FAO · Faro · 76 km

Description ⚙: The Tivoli Marina Vilamoura offers guests two distinct views: south-facing rooms look over the open Atlantic Ocean, while north-facing rooms look directly into Vilamoura's marina. Higher floors on the south side deliver the clearest oceanic sightlines. The hotel has been a beacon of luxury in the Algarve for years, constantly renovating to maintain its standing. The Purobeach Vilamoura beachfront area provides direct beach access with sun loungers and dining. The hotel's proximity to Vilamoura's Marina ensures excellent dining options within walking distance.

Hotel Tagline: Rooftop views sweep across Faro's city and the Ria Formosa beyond.
Summary: Not a beach hotel — the draw here is the rooftop infinity pool with sweeping views over Faro and the Ria Formosa, and the Hábito restaurant’s city-facing terrace. The Michelin Key distinction earned in 2025 confirms the calibre. An easy base for the ferry to the barrier islands.
Description ⚙: 3HB Faro opened in June 2021 as the first five-star hotel in Faro's city centre, earning a Michelin Key distinction in 2025. Interior designer Paulo Lobo, based in Porto, conceived the urban-chic aesthetic throughout the 103 rooms. The rooftop infinity pool delivers sweeping panoramic views over Faro and the Ria Formosa. The Hábito restaurant, specializing in Mediterranean cuisine inspired by Algarve traditions, occupies the rooftop with city-facing views. The hotel provides easy access to Faro's historic downtown and the ferry to the Ria Formosa barrier islands.

Description ⚙: Situated on a 220-hectare estate within the Vicentina Coast Natural Park near Aljezur, Praia do Canal Nature Retreat — a Small Luxury Hotels of the World member — provides access to some of the Algarve's least-visited beaches including Arrifana, Canal, and Bordeira. The rooftop suites each feature a private marble plunge pool with panoramic views of the ocean and the protected landscape. The Azeitona restaurant pays homage to traditional Alentejo and Algarve cuisines using local seasonal produce. The award-winning Esteva Spa offers soothing views of the surrounding nature.

The crown jewel is the Lounge Terrace Suite, captivating guests with 360-degree views of the surrounding countryside, mountains, and distant ocean. The À TERRA restaurant draws on the property's own herb garden for its honest, flavourful cooking. Guests can access Fuzeta Island in the Ria Formosa via a daily summer shuttle and boat service.

Rooms on the second and third floors face east for the sunrise over the river and the marina. The hotel’s Beach Club adds Atlantic access a short shuttle away.
Description ⚙: Situated in Vila Real de Santo António at the easternmost point of the Algarve, the Bordoy Grand House Algarve is a restored 1926 Belle Époque mansion — the first five-star hotel in the historic town. The property offers direct views of the Guadiana River and Spain on the opposite bank. Second and third floor rooms face east, providing an ideal vantage point for sunrise over the river and marina. The hotel's Beach Club, a short shuttle drive away, features an infinity pool above the river mouth. The charming, fully-restored boutique hotel, owned by the Bordoy Hotels group, combines Art Nouveau elements with contemporary comforts.

Hotel Tagline: From mountain terraces above the coastal plain, the sea appears on clear days.
Summary: The only mountain address on this page: positioned in the Monchique range above the coastal plain, with panoramic terraces that reach to the sea on clear days. The Caldas spring waters run through the spa. Serra restaurant draws on local mountain ingredients. Fóia, at 902 metres, is a short drive.
Description ⚙: Planted in the rugged Monchique mountain range, the Monchique Resort & Spa offers a tranquil inland retreat above the coastal plain. This mountain haven is renowned for its pristine environment and access to one of Europe's most alkaline spring water sources — the Caldas waters. Suites offer balconies and private panoramic terraces with sun loungers facing the mountains, with the sea visible on clear days. The Serra restaurant draws on local mountain ingredients and regional traditions. Part of the Natura 2000 Network, the resort is also a destination for cyclists. The nearby Fóia viewpoint at 902 metres above sea level is the highest point in the Algarve.
Address: Lugar do Montinho, 8550-232, Portugal
Nearest Airports: FAO · Faro · 82 km

Hotel Tagline: Clifftop above the Atlantic, where the light arrives from both sides of the day.
Summary: A clifftop Lagos resort organized across five wings inspired by the Descobrimentos. Rooms on the upper floors catch Atlantic light from both angles; sunsets are unhurried from the balcony. The Senses Restaurant and spa circuit — sauna, Turkish bath, ice fountain — earn a second evening.
Description ⚙: Located in the coastal town of Lagos, Cascade Wellness Resort offers a clifftop retreat organized across five wings inspired by the Portuguese Descobrimentos. Upper-floor rooms and suites deliver Atlantic Ocean views with both sunrise and sunset angles. The hotel sits near Porto de Mós Beach and is within 30 minutes' walk of Dona Ana Beach. The Boavista Golf Course with panoramic sea views is easily accessible. The Senses Restaurant serves fine dining, while the spa includes a sauna, jacuzzi, Turkish bath, and ice fountain. The resort features state-of-the-art Technogym equipment in its fitness centre.
Address: R. das Ilhas, 8600-513 Lagos, Portugal
Nearest Airports: FAO · Faro · 94 km

Hotel Tagline: From a promontory above the Gulf of Salerno, the infinity pool's edge meets open sea below.
Summary: A former 17th-century Dominican monastery on a Conca dei Marini promontory, with 20 rooms over the Gulf of Salerno. Deluxe Terrace suites go furthest toward the horizon. The infinity pool carved into Monte San Pancrazio and Michelin-starred Il Refettorio’s terrace are the two standout views.
Description ⚙: Monastero Santa Rosa Hotel & Spa is a five-star boutique hotel in a 17th-century former Dominican monastery in Conca dei Marini, on a promontory between Praiano and Amalfi. The 20 rooms and suites face the Gulf of Salerno; Deluxe Terrace suites provide the clearest sightline to the horizon. The infinity pool is carved into Monte San Pancrazio, with the Gulf visible directly below its edge — the sensation of swimming above the sea is immediate. Michelin-starred Il Refettorio, led by chef Alfonso Crescenzo, occupies a panoramic terrace above the water with a seasonal Mediterranean menu sourced from the monastery's own garden. The spa uses the original monastery vaults, including an 80-square-metre double-height vaulted space. The Path of the Gods trail begins near the property.
Address: Via Roma, 2, 84010 Conca dei Marini SA, Italy
Nearest Airports: SUF · Salerno · 46 km; NAP · Naples · 65 km

La Sponda, lit each evening by four hundred candles, holds a Michelin star; the Don’t Worry Bar spins vinyl until late. The pool is framed by lemon trees.
Description ⚙: Le Sirenuse is a five-star hotel in Positano, opened by the Sersale family in 1951 in their private villa, 70 metres above the beach. All 58 rooms face the Tyrrhenian Sea, Positano's stacked hillside houses, and the dome of the Chiesa di Santa Maria Assunta. Michelin-starred La Sponda, led by chef Gennaro Russo, is lit each evening by four hundred candles on a sea-view terrace. The Don't Worry Music Bar, in its current vinyl DJ format since 2024, occupies the heart of the hotel. Aldo's Cocktail Bar and Seafood Grill is a further sea-view dining option. The pool is framed by lemon trees. Boat excursions depart from below. Recommended rooms: any sea-facing category; Junior Suites and above for the largest terraces.
Address: Via Cristoforo Colombo, 30, 84017 Positano SA, Italy
Nearest Airports: NAP · Naples · 64 km

Description ⚙: Il San Pietro di Positano is a five-star boutique hotel on a cliff south of Positano where every room and suite faces the sea and the rugged coastline. Suite 59, the Virginia Suite, is the most photographed room on the property — the room to request. A hotel lift reaches the private beach club in a natural cove in under one minute; orange sun loungers line the exclusive waterfront. The half-moon pool faces Praiano. The tennis court sits between the rocks and the sea. Michelin-starred Zass prohibits mobile phones during service and draws on an organic garden for its ingredients. A complimentary shuttle reaches Positano centre in five minutes.
Address: Via Laurito, 2, 84017 Positano SA, Italy
Nearest Airports: NAP · Naples · 63 km

In summer, complimentary cruises run to Amalfi and Positano.
Description ⚙: Caruso, A Belmond Hotel, Amalfi Coast is a five-star hotel in an 11th-century palace in Ravello, 365 metres above the sea. The 50 rooms and suites overlook the Gulf of Salerno, Minori, Maiori, and the surrounding mountains. The heated infinity pool mirrors sky and mountains simultaneously and is among the most photographed on the Amalfi Coast. Ristorante Belvedere serves Italian cuisine at the same panoramic elevation and is open to non-guests by reservation. In summer, complimentary cruises and shuttles run to Amalfi and Positano below. The wellness centre and spa complete the on-site offer.
Address: Piazza S. Giovanni del Toro, 2, 84010 Ravello SA, Italy
Nearest Airports: NAP · Naples · 61 km; SUF · Salerno · 63 km

Restaurant Al Mare sits at sea level with Tyrrhenian views. The beach club is accessible by lifts carved into the cliff rock, with a saltwater heated pool. The 37 rooms and 4 apartments feature nautical-style furnishings with antique yacht details and Vietri ceramics. Restaurant L'Antica Cartiera occupies a sea-view terrace. Hotel Tagline: Upper floors of a 1665 canal-side palace, facing the Prinsengracht directly.
Summary: Opened May 2025 in the former Palace of Justice on the Prinsengracht — Amsterdam’s last permitted luxury hotel in a heritage building. Grand Premier Canal View rooms on the upper floors face the canal directly. Worth staying for the building alone; the view makes its own case.
Description ⚙: Opened May 2025 in the former Palace of Justice (built 1665), at Prinsengracht 432–436 in Amsterdam’s UNESCO World Heritage-listed canal district. The last new hotel development permitted within a monumental building in Amsterdam, following a decade-long restoration. 134 rooms and suites, including five signature Houses, designed by Studio Piet Boon with over 1,000 artworks throughout; courtyard gardens by landscape architect Piet Oudolf. Premier Canal View rooms and Grand Premier Canal View rooms face the Prinsengracht directly from upper floors. Canal View suites range from Junior to Signature level. Three restaurants and bars: Eeuwen (seasonal Dutch cuisine by chef David Ordóñez, with terrace), The Court (all-day café and patisserie), and Advocatuur bar (in-house Prøvo jenever distillery in former legal chambers). Asaya Spa with Ayurvedic treatments, heated indoor pool, fitness centre. Private salon boat on the Prinsengracht for canal excursions, styled by Studio Piet Boon. Monthly art exhibitions at The Gallery.
Address: Prinsengracht 432 – 436, 1017 KE Amsterdam, Netherlands
Nearest Airports: AMS · Schiphol · 16 km; RTM · Rotterdam The Hague · 67 km

Description ⚙: The Dylan Amsterdam, on the Keizersgracht canal, is a boutique hotel with 40 individually designed rooms and suites, each inspired by the Netherlands’ Asian colonial past. Situated within the Nine Streets complex, the hotel is moments from Dam Square and Leidseplein. The candlelit garden terrace provides an evening setting overlooking the property’s secluded interior. Restaurant Vinkeles, in the building’s 18th-century former bakery, holds two Michelin stars under chef Jurgen van der Zalm. The Serendipity building annex was fully renovated in May 2024. With 640 rooms and suites, it stands as one of Auckland's finest hotels, renowned for exceptional quality. The 17th-floor Chairman Suite with Club Access steals the show with its expansive size and floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows. A multitude of dining choices awaits guests, ranging from wholesome breakfasts at Eight Restaurant to delectable treats at the Chandelier Lounge. The Cordis, Auckland offers pampering treatments at the Chuan Spa, invigorating workouts at the Health Club, and a serene rooftop pool and jacuzzi. Harbour View Rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows framing the glistening expanse of the harbour, with automated blackout blinds that reveal the water at the press of a button. Club InterContinental delivers private check-in, personalised service, and access to a dedicated Club Lounge with harbour views. The hotel's signature restaurant, Advieh, was named New Zealand Hotel Restaurant of the Year 2024 at the HM Aotearoa-Pacific Awards. The property also holds Qualmark Sustainable Tourism certification.

East and south-facing rooms and suites offer extraordinary views of the city skyline and the iconic Sky Tower, while north-facing accommodations provide a picturesque outlook over the vibrant harbour, with the Auckland Harbour Bridge visible in the distance. The Harbour Suite and Executive Rooftop Suite are two of the most exquisite offerings among the hotel's 195 rooms. The hotel's Captain's Bar features an inviting terrace revealing fascinating Auckland vistas. Onemata restaurant — named New Zealand Hotel Restaurant of the Year at the 2025 HM Aotearoa-Pacific Awards — serves a seasonally driven menu celebrating the finest local ingredients. The 25-metre heated infinity pool overlooks Wynyard Quarter's marina. The Spa at Park Hyatt Auckland offers vitality pools and a full suite of bespoke wellness treatments.

Sixteen storeys of boldly conceived rooms and suites, each inspired by New Zealand's volcanic landscape, sweep upward to commanding views over the Waitematā Harbour and the city skyline. Selected suites include private balconies and separate lounge areas. The hotel's most dramatic view destination is HI-SO, the rooftop bar at the summit of the building, where cocktails are served against an unobstructed panorama of the harbour and the Auckland skyline. One floor below, Harbour Society serves reimagined Asian-inspired dishes with the Waitematā Harbour as a luminous backdrop. At street level, Javalab Café blends French patisserie craft with artisan coffee. SO/SPA offers a curated menu of treatments supported by an indoor heated pool.

QT Auckland boasts Esther, a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant that has swiftly claimed its spot as one of the top dining destinations in the city, and the Rooftop at QT bar with panoramic views over the harbour and marina. Perched near the Viaduct Harbour, QT Auckland offers easy access to Auckland's treasures including the Auckland Fish Market, Silo Park, and the Sky Tower.

The glistening waters of the harbour take centre stage, and harbour-facing rooms with balconies allow guests to fully embrace the setting. The FISH restaurant offers an awe-inspiring harbour view and serves the finest locally sourced seafood. A slender outdoor pool creates an illusion of merging with the harbour's waters. The Grand Ballroom was relaunched in March 2024 following an extensive refurbishment with a custom lighting sculpture by James Russ Studio. Facilities include a heated indoor swimming pool and a sauna.

Description ⚙: Mandarin Oriental Wangfujing, Beijing opened in March 2019 as the brand's Beijing debut, occupying the top two floors of WF Central on Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng. The 73 rooms and suites, designed by Hirsch Bedner Associates, are among the largest in the city, starting at 55 square metres. The hotel was built within the Forbidden City's protected zone under a 32-metre height restriction; the building steps down westward to respect the palace compound. Many rooms have direct Forbidden City views through floor-to-ceiling windows. The Premier Suite offers the most unobstructed sightline; the Oriental Suite adds a six-seat dining table and private terrace; the Garden Suite extends to a 300-square-metre private courtyard. MO Bar's outdoor terrace and the Mandarin Grill — the only luxury hotel grill in Beijing with Forbidden City garden-terrace views — both open onto the rooftop garden. Café Zi serves contemporary Cantonese cuisine. The hotel holds a Forbes Travel Guide 5-star rating.

China Grill on Level 66 is a 360-degree panoramic restaurant topped by a glass pyramid; China Bar on Level 65 serves cocktails with the same citywide outlook and live entertainment. The Dining Room on Level 63 offers Chinese cuisine and seasonal afternoon tea. The 59th-floor Sky Pool is a 25-metre heated indoor lap pool with CBD views; the fitness centre occupies the same floor. Description ⚙: The 1929 Edificio Mihanovich was designed as a lighthouse — a 20-story tower on Calle Arroyo built so its commissioner could watch his ships depart across the Río de la Plata. Nearly a century later, the building reopened in January 2024 as Casa Lucia, member of the Meliá Collection, and was named Best Hotel in Argentina 2025. Set in the heart of Recoleta, it pairs an art deco silhouette with interiors inspired by Argentina's golden age of 1880 to 1940: warm timber paneling, marble bathrooms, and black-and-white photographs of Buenos Aires by Argentine photographer Ricardo Piñeiro. Of the 142 rooms and suites, the Tower Suites at the top frame panoramic views of the Buenos Aires skyline and the Río de la Plata — the same river the original lighthouse was built to overlook. Cantina restaurant is led by chef Julián del Pino; Le Club Bacan is the ground-floor cocktail bar with a Buenos Aires skyline mural painted by local artist Alejandra Winkhaus.

The Viceroy Chicago features 180 charming rooms, enriched by much-appreciated rain showers and floor-to-ceiling windows; the Deluxe and Grand Lake categories, with scenic water vistas, collect our preferences. On the hotel's 16th floor, the two-bedroom spectacular Penthouse Suite reigns supreme, unveiling the most dramatic vistas imaginable. Description ⚙: The Langham Chicago, an exquisite five-star downtown hotel flanked by the river, the iconic Marina City Goldberg towers, and the super-tall Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago, excels in the art of hospitality. Many of the lavish rooms and suites, bathed by plenty of natural light, captivate with stunning views of the Chicago skyline, often graced by Lake Michigan and the Chicago River. The interior decor, hinting at modernist influences, features a masterful selection of materials and a palette of neutral tones brilliantly harmonized with marble-filled bathrooms. For those who feel puzzled when picking their quarters at this posh address, we recommend the One Bedroom Lake View Suite, which is always an irreprehensible accommodation choice. The hotel's vistas continue to impress from the on-site Travelle restaurant, where an ode to American cuisine is played on every meal. Deserving an extra word of praise is the hotel's corner-installed Travelle Bar, presenting floor-to-ceiling windows with captivating views of the river and the surrounding skyscrapers of downtown Chicago. The exclusive 12th-floor Club Level offers a private retreat with scenic views of the river and lake and a complimentary breakfast buffet, afternoon tea, and hors d'oeuvres. Following a day filled with city exploration, why not unwind with wellness offerings like a heated indoor pool, a Himalayan salt sauna, or perhaps a revitalizing full-body massage at the Chuan Spa?

Description ⚙: Even if the name it bears may not always be consensual, all guests seem to agree: the Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago is one of the best luxury hotels in Chicago, period. Nestled within a sleek 92-story tower that is said to have inspired the Burj Khalifa project in Dubai, this downtown Chicago hotel has been distinguished with the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star award every year since 2013 — one of the longest consecutive runs in the city — and it is easy to understand why. The Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago exudes sophistication, and its panoramic views are unmatched; these include Lake Michigan and multiple Chicago landmarks, namely The Wrigley Building on nearby Michigan Avenue. Perhaps the biggest challenge for guests-to-be is picking one among the many room and suite categories. Accommodations vary in size and view they offer; some feature fully-equipped kitchens, which are ideal for families visiting the city. Fitness and wellness aficionados will be happy to learn that the Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago offers one of the most modern and largest fitness clubs and spas in town, complemented by an inviting indoor heated swimming pool.

Description ⚙: The Four Seasons Chicago, one of the city's most prestigious five-star hotels, rests steps away from North Michigan Avenue in the so-called Magnificent Mile. Adjacent to this sophisticated retreat, guests can indulge in upscale shopping at the 900 North Michigan Shops complex, featuring many high-end labels. Enhancing the quintessential Chicago luxury experience, a visit to the nearby 875 North Michigan Avenue observation deck unveils breathtaking city vistas. Resting bags at this fabulous Chicago downtown hotel also means taking in awe-inspiring views of Lake Michigan and the storied Chicago skyline, especially when getting hold of one of the lake-view rooms located between the 32nd and 46th floors, whose interiors boast a color palette of calming blues and taupes, or opulent browns and silvers. For those enamored with spa experiences, the Four Seasons Chicago suggests a night spa relaxation event, which involves a couple's massage, champagne, and sweet treats, ending with a dip in an infinity-edge pool facing the cityscape. As if additional reasons to visit were needed, Adorn, celebrated as one of the premier New American restaurants in the city, provides the perfect chance to savor inventive signature dishes that captivate both the eye and the palate.
Address: 120 E Delaware Pl, Chicago, IL 60611, USA

Description ⚙: Indulge in a magnificent skyline panorama at The Peninsula Chicago, one of the most awarded hotels in downtown Chicago, offering views that also encompass the historical Chicago Water Tower. Recognized for perfectionism since its doors first opened in 2001 — and celebrating its 25th anniversary in 2026 — guests reap the rewards of Eastern elegance when choosing to check in at this Asian-influenced luxury hotel. For instance, surrendering to a delectable meal at Shanghai Terrace, acclaimed as one of Chicago's top hotel restaurants, featuring delightful Chinese cuisine and captivating city vistas, is the ideal romantic dining experience. Located on the hotel's 6th floor is the hip Z Bar, which, apart from being the ideal spot to sample imaginative cocktails, stars a rooftop terrace presiding over Michigan Avenue from where the Water Tower can be admired. Most of The Peninsula Chicago's luxurious accommodations feature that much-desired city or lake view; still, the super-spacious Lake and Water Tower suites, each featuring a carefully positioned telescope by the window, ensure a dreamful stay in the Windy City. The 19th-floor swimming pool, with bay windows offering skyline views, adds a magical touch to the stay. The Peninsula Chicago has received the Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star rating every year since 2001.

Description ⚙: The Headland Hotel and Spa is and feels like a luxury resort, where guests feel welcomed with a blend of grand traditions and modern amenities. The rooms and suites, some with ocean views, offer a comfortable base for a Cornwall getaway. Families will be particularly pleased when staying at The Trevose Suite, a two-bedroom accommodation with a balcony, heavenly beds, and luxurious bath amenities. The Headland Hotel and Spa proudly invites guests to its spa, perhaps the best in the region, with facilities including a child-free spa pool, hydrotherapy pool, Swedish sauna, and aromatherapy shower. The Aqua Club's Sunset Spa Pool and Edge Pool both overlook the Atlantic. The fabulous ocean views continue at the hotel's restaurant, RenMor, which translates to 'restaurant by the sea' in the local dialect. After a reported investment of £3 million, this fine-dining venue debuted in 2023, celebrating Cornish gastronomy with locally sourced produce.

Description ⚙: Guardians of absolute serenity and a zen-like stay in Cornwall, the Fistral Beach Hotel and Spa caters exclusively to adults. Those who look for hotels with spas in Cornwall often end up resting their bags and souls at this property. Apart from an inviting heated indoor Vitality Pool and a well-equipped gym, the wellness team has designed multiple packages to deliver the utmost relaxing experience, including rejuvenating treatments, romantic couple massages, and two-course dinners at the on-site, award-winning Dune Restaurant, holder of 2 AA Rosettes. Sleeping at the Fistral Beach Hotel and Spa is all but ordinary: guests are treated to soothing Atlantic vistas that are a feast for the eyes. The sea-view balcony rooms have all one needs, including luxurious bath amenities; for those who wish to take advantage of extra space while contemplating the glistening ocean, The Suite is the ultimate perk — the panoramic whirlpool overlooking the extensive Fistral Beach is almost too good to be true.

Surrounded by vibrant wildflowers and overlooking the sea, the luxurious boutique hotel invites leisurely, soul-soothing walks around its grounds and along the coastal path. Offering flawless service, thorough attention to detail, and modern upscale amenities, this establishment stands in a class of its own. The guest rooms exude sophistication with a contemporary and nautical flair, complemented by high-end amenities. The north-facing Superior Oceanside accommodations, with sweeping ocean vistas, are all one can ask for. The hotel's sun terrace and beer garden also provide stunning sea views. The restaurant showcases gourmet seafood selections crafted from locally sourced produce, served with floor-to-ceiling glass windows overlooking the Atlantic.

Summary: Thirty-seven rooms on a Mawgan Porth clifftop, every one facing the Atlantic — balcony, terrace, or rooftop viewing pod, no exceptions. The clifftop hot tubs are bookable at sunset; the path to the beach takes three minutes. Ask for an Indulgent suite for the widest terrace.
Description ⚙: Built into the clifftops above Mawgan Porth, the Scarlet Hotel was designed around a single premise: every room faces the Atlantic without compromise. All 37 accommodations — from the Just Right rooms to the expansive Indulgent suites — open onto a private balcony, terrace, or rooftop viewing pod, each looking directly over the sea and the sandy arc of Mawgan Porth beach below. Founded by three sisters and run as an adults-only property, the Scarlet is an eco-hotel where no material detail is accidental — from the unbleached organic robes to the sea-thrift rooftop designed to recede into the clifftop rather than impose on it. Interiors draw on the colours of the surrounding coastline, with original works by Cornish artists throughout the public spaces. The Scarlet Spa features clifftop hot tubs bookable at sunset, a natural reed-filtered pool, and a cedar wood sauna in the meadow garden, from which a gate leads directly onto the South West Coast Path and down to Mawgan Porth beach. The holistic treatment philosophy is rooted in Ayurvedic principles, with a deep relaxation room fitted with suspended cocoon pods. The Scarlet Restaurant changes its menu daily, built around seasonal and locally sourced produce, served in a light-filled room with an outdoor clifftop terrace overlooking the sea.

Description ⚙: The Esplanade Hotel is a seaside retreat along Fistral Beach in Newquay, next to its sister Fistral Beach Hotel and Spa; this four-star property is a regular in Cornwall's best hotel lists. Renowned as the premier beach in this coastal town, it is an ideal destination for family adventures, romantic getaways, golf breaks, or surf trips with friends. Comfortable rooms with dramatic ocean views provide an ideal base for a Cornwall getaway; some are decorated with surfboards hanging on the walls and by-the-window chaise longues. This beachfront hotel covers every need of those who wish to hit the waves, from equipment to lessons at the on-site Quiksilver Surf School. Six other superb beaches and the famous Cribbar Surfing Point are within reach. Newquay is a short stroll away with its shops and picturesque harbour. For guests preferring a spa day, indoor relaxation is made possible with a heated pool, hot tub, and sauna.

The hotel's setting, erected on the beach at sea level and flanked by cliffs, is absolutely unique. Guests who lodge here can even experience sand on their toes without needing to leave their rooms; such is the case of the Hot Tub Beach Suite, which features a one-of-a-kind private beach garden overlooking the Atlantic, in addition to king-size beds and generous space. Also worth mentioning are the gorgeous Colonial Rooms, which follow tropical-inspired decoration and emanate romance while offering sea-facing beach terraces. The pleasure of eating also takes center stage at this sea-caressed hotel: from invigorating breakfasts to cocktails enriched with glorious sunsets, the Colonial restaurant doesn't disappoint; over the years, it has become an institution for experiencing Newquay's beach vibes up close.

Description ⚙: Situated in the charming fishing town of St. Mawes, this historic hotel takes pride in 19 well-appointed rooms adorned with personal touches, attentive service, and exquisite Cornish gourmet offerings at the hotel's sea-facing restaurant. Those who lodge at The Idle Rocks will be swept away by vistas of the Cornish countryside, breathtaking sea views, and generous hospitality. Guests checking into the nautically-inspired Grand Sea View room are treated to a show-stopping view of the morning sun rising over the bird-flanked harbour. As they sip on the hotel's signature drink, The Idle Mary, they can lounge on the fashionable sea-view terrace and observe the fishing boats and yachts coming to life in the harbour. A leisurely stroll into the town offers opportunities to sightsee, visit galleries, and refresh in local pubs. A trip to St. Mawes Castle, an imposing 16th-century Tudor military architectural masterpiece, is a must — not only dripping with history but providing stirring coastal views.

The hotel offers 31 rooms, with some featuring the much-desired sea view. The extra-spacious Balcony Bliss rooms are equipped with panoramic balconies offering sweeping vistas of the Newquay Golf Course and Fistral Beach in the distance. The bar area and terrace are lovely, and the location, halfway between Fistral Beach and the town of Newquay, is genuinely convenient.

The stylish guest rooms, adorned in soothing shades of blue and white with mid-century Ercol furnishings, provide captivating harbour views. The hosts extend impeccable service, lavish breakfasts made from locally sourced and organic produce, and valuable guidance for a memorable Cornish holiday. In the heart of St. Ives, Trevose Harbour House provides easy access to museums, art galleries, beaches, cafes, shops, restaurants, and the Barbara Hepworth Museum and Sculpture Garden.

Description ⚙: The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas — formerly the Four Seasons Resort and Club Dallas at Las Colinas — completed a $55 million renovation and rebranded on January 23, 2024. Hotel Tagline: From a 13th-century tower, Brunelleschi's cupola and the Arno stretch across two rooftop terraces.
Summary: Two guests-only rooftop terraces inside a 13th-century tower at Via Tornabuoni 1: the Dome Terrace holds the full skyline from Brunelleschi’s cupola to Giotto’s bell tower; the Arno Terrace looks toward Palazzo Pitti and Forte Belvedere. The Panoramic Suite adds a private balcony above the river — verified room by room, and certified.
Description ⚙: Antica Torre di Via Tornabuoni 1 is a luxury boutique residence housed in a 13th-century tower-house built by the Guelf Ruggerini family, at Via de' Tornabuoni 1, Florence — the city's most prestigious shopping street, adjacent to the Ponte Santa Trinita. The building was later the Gianfigliazzi family residence (mentioned in Dante's Divine Comedy) until the late 18th century and hosted aristocratic and artistic guests during the Grand Tour era. It was restored and reopened in 2001, occupying both the medieval tower and the neighboring Palazzo Gianfigliazzi. The hotel has approximately 25 rooms and suites, each individually designed with wood-beam ceilings, stone archways, original frescoes, and Tuscan antiques. Key suite categories include: the Panoramic Suite, with a private terrace directly overlooking the Arno River and Ponte Vecchio; the Hammam Suite, with a private wellness area including jetted tub and steam room; the Presidential Granduca Suite on the 6th floor, with an exclusive private terrace above Via de' Tornabuoni and a spa area. The two rooftop terraces are exclusive to hotel guests. The Dome Terrace offers an unobstructed view of Brunelleschi's dome and Giotto's bell tower. The Arno Terrace frames Palazzo Pitti, Forte Belvedere, and the dome of Santo Spirito, with the Arno below. The TornaB Panoramic Bar, renovated in 2025, operates on the rooftop and is accessible to non-guests by reservation. The hotel holds The Most Perfect View certification, awarded following a comprehensive room-by-room view audit.
Address: Via de' Tornabuoni, 1, 50123 Firenze FI, Italy

Description ⚙: Located on the banks of the River Arno, halfway between Ponte Santa Trinita and Ponte Vecchio, the Hotel Lungarno is a luxurious five-star hotel in the heart of Florence. Its unique setting allows sensational views of the Arno River and the city's most iconic landmarks, including the Ponte Vecchio, Duomo, Palazzo Pitti, and the Uffizi Gallery. The building was originally a palace owned by the Medici family. In 2017, marking its 50th anniversary, the Hotel Lungarno reopened its doors to guests after a careful intervention. This exceptional Florentine property features 65 elegant rooms and suites with all the contemporary amenities one would expect from a luxury hotel. The best suites with Florence views include the Rooftop Terrace Suite River View (360-degree views), closely followed by the Picasso, Bueno, and Cocteau river suites. The hotel's award-winning restaurant, Borgo San Jacopo, is worth praise, where the most romantic tables facing the Arno and Ponte Vecchio leave patrons in awe.

The hotel offers stunning views across the Ponte Vecchio and the picturesque hills of Tuscany. Its central location means that guests are just a stroll away from the wonders of the Uffizi and the majestic Duomo. The St. Regis Florence boasts 80 luxuriously appointed guest rooms and 19 suites, each an epitome of refined taste. The suites offer a distinctive selection featuring one-of-a-kind antique artwork and impressive views of the Arno River, including the famed Ponte Vecchio to the left. The hotel's crowning glory includes a terrace suite designed by Bottega Veneta, offering guests wool carpets sourced from New Zealand. Regarding dining, guests can enjoy a meal at the Winter Garden Restaurant, sip a cocktail at The St. Regis Terrace, or indulge in a bespoke afternoon tea featuring a Dammann Frères selection. Description ⚙: The Hotel Savoy, a five-star luxury hotel managed by Rocco Forte Hotels, offers an exquisite blend of Florentine heritage and contemporary style. Located on the Piazza della Repubblica, it stands as a beacon of elegance in the bustling atmosphere of Florence. The hotel's interiors were shaped by Olga Polizzi, Head of Design at Rocco Forte Hotels, and Laudomia Pucci. Junior suites feature Carrara marble bathrooms and views of Piazza della Repubblica and the Duomo. Rooms are adorned with fine Tuscan silks, local artwork, and furniture. The culinary experience centers on Irene, the hotel's restaurant, where Chef Fulvio Pierangelini's seasonally driven Tuscan menu is served in a freshly renovated space featuring walnut panelling and marble floors, reopened in April 2025 following the hotel's 25th anniversary renovation. Adjacent to Irene, Bar Artemisia — opened in April 2025 — pairs a Caravaggio-inspired interior with cocktails by Maestro Salvatore Calabrese. On the fifth floor, the Spa Suite offers views of Florence across two levels. Spa treatments are created in collaboration with Officina Profumo Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella.

Description ⚙: The Westin Excelsior, Florence, located on the Arno's south bank, offers an experience that combines historical elegance with contemporary luxury. Originally built in 1863, the hotel has a long and fascinating history, hosting numerous famous guests including royalty, celebrities, and political figures. With 171 elegantly renovated rooms and suites, the hotel provides guests with a full range of room categories. Pressing the number six on the hotel's lift equals arriving at SE·STO on Arno, a glass rooftop bar and restaurant with breathtaking 360-degree views; reservations are advised as it gets crowded quickly. A brief, pleasant walk separates guests from the Uffizi Gallery, the Duomo, and the Ponte Vecchio.

Suites overlooking the Giardino della Gherardesca are the reason to book a higher category. Il Palagio, Michelin-starred under Chef Paolo Lavezzini, stays on the same grounds.
Description ⚙: Located at Borgo Pinti 99 in Florence, the Four Seasons Hotel Firenze is a renowned luxury hotel ranked #9 on The World's 50 Best Hotels 2025 — a position it has held for three consecutive years since the list's debut in 2023. The 15th-century palazzo, once owned by a councilman to the Medici family, features fresco-lined walls, Italianate marble, and decor that echoes the grandeur of Florentine nobility. The luxurious hotel preserves a former confessional room used by the Medici family, now serving as a unique setting for intimate dining. Accommodations include historical suites with frescoes and centuries-old restored furniture boasting views of the hotel's 15th-century Botanical Gardens of Giardino della Gherardesca. The Palazzo del Nero, completely renovated and reopened in 2024, adds an intimate historic palace to the grounds, separated from Palazzo della Gherardesca by the tranquil Gherardesca Garden. Dining at the Four Seasons Hotel Firenze includes Il Palagio, the Michelin-starred flagship restaurant under the guidance of Chef Paolo Lavezzini. The hotel also offers hot air balloon tours over Tuscany's Chianti region and various curated itineraries.

Hotel Tagline: From the sixth-floor pool, the Duomo sits at eye level with nothing in between.
Summary: The rooftop pool on the sixth floor of this 13th-century palazzo faces the Duomo with nothing in between. Carlo Scarpa’s 1958 redesign left floating staircases and frescoed rooms; the view it left was the Duomo at eye level — best timed to a Terrace Negroni at sunset.
Description ⚙: Grand Hotel Minerva is a 4-star superior hotel on Piazza Santa Maria Novella, Florence, occupying a 13th-century palazzo originally built as housing for the monks of Santa Maria Novella. The building was architecturally transformed in 1958 by Italian modernist Carlo Scarpa — known for his use of traditional materials and geometric precision — who installed the rooftop pool, floating staircases, glass walls, and a geometric brick façade still intact today. The hotel has been owned by the Maestrelli family (Collezione Em group) since 1992, who preserved Scarpa's design while adding contemporary artworks and antiques from Florentine noble families. The hotel has 97 rooms and suites, including four rooms with original 17th-century frescoes and two with coffered wooden ceilings from the 1300s. Upper-floor suites offer views of the Duomo dome and the striped marble façade of the Basilica di Santa Maria Novella. The sixth-floor rooftop heated pool (28°C, open April–October) has direct sightlines to the Duomo. The rooftop terrace remains open year-round. La Buona Novella, the ground-floor restaurant, serves contemporary Florentine and Mediterranean cuisine, with an al fresco terrace on the piazza in summer.
Address: P.za di Santa Maria Novella, 16, 50123 Firenze FI, Italy
Nearest Airports: FLR · Florence Peretola · 9 km

Description ⚙: This former Fiesole monastery, just a 15-minute drive from the bustling city of Florence, boasts breathtaking views over Tuscany's largest city and the Chianti countryside, a vista once enjoyed by Napoleon Bonaparte in 1796. The hotel's 42 accommodations encapsulate the spirit of the Renaissance, with each space uniquely crafted for relaxation. The sumptuous Double Rooms, Junior Suites, and the exclusive Limonaia Suite and Villa all feature king-size or twin beds, marble bathrooms, and in some cases a private plunge pool. Villa San Michele's heated outdoor swimming pool, surrounded by white lounge chairs and umbrellas, provides a serene setting and sweeping vistas of Florence below. An on-site Cookery School is available for guests. The La Loggia Restaurant presents a signature fine dining experience with dishes rooted in Tuscan culture, utilizing sustainable ingredients. A complimentary shuttle runs to and from Florence's city centre.

Description ⚙: Hotel degli Orafi is a 4-star hotel on Lungarno Archibusieri, Florence, housed in a 13th-century Augustinian convent 50 meters south of Ponte Vecchio, adjacent to the Uffizi Gallery. The property retains the ruins of a medieval tower destroyed by the Ghibellines in 1260, partially restored; the modern library displays original 12th-century frescoes discovered during restoration. The hotel is independently owned by the Brini-Batacchi family and gained worldwide recognition as the principal setting for James Ivory's 1985 Academy Award-winning film A Room with a View. The hotel has 42 rooms in Classic, Executive, and Junior Suite categories, decorated in the grand Florentine style with exposed wooden beams and period furnishings. The fourth-floor Room with a View Executive Room features a private terrace directly above the Arno and Ponte Vecchio. The breakfast room, occupying a former 19th-century ballroom with hand-painted frescoed ceiling, overlooks the Arno River and Via dei Georgofili. The fifth-floor rooftop bar and terrace offers views of the Duomo, Palazzo Vecchio, the Vasari Corridor, and the Florentine hills.
View Subjects: Florence Cathedral (Duomo), Arno River, Ponte Vecchio

Description ⚙: Plaza Hotel Lucchesi is a 4-star hotel on Lungarno della Zecca Vecchia, Florence, founded in 1860 as one of the first hotels in the city. The property was significantly renovated in 2014, when the Empireo rooftop terrace and heated outdoor swimming pool were constructed. It is part of the ToFlorence Hotels group. The hotel has 92 rooms and 10 suites. Superior rooms offer views of the Arno River, Piazzale Michelangelo, or the Church of Santa Croce. Deluxe rooms have panoramic windows and spacious balconies with either Arno and San Miniato al Monte views, or Santa Croce views. The hotel's eastern Lungarno position provides a view corridor toward Piazzale Michelangelo and the Tuscan hills that is underrepresented in central Florence hotel listings. The Empireo Rooftop bar and pool delivers 360° views of the Florence skyline including the Duomo, the Arno, San Miniato al Monte, and the Tuscan hills. The rooftop is open to non-guests for cocktails and an aperitivo buffet from June through September.

Description ⚙: Portrait Firenze is a boutique hotel under the umbrella of the Ferragamo family-owned Lungarno Collection, offering sublime views of the Arno River and the much-celebrated Ponte Vecchio. The hotel's location proves ideal, only a brief walk to Piazza della Signoria. The hotel boasts 37 spacious and elegantly designed suites, each with a unique style and character. Most accommodations feature large windows that offer breathtaking river views. The 6th-floor Ponte Vecchio Suite is the hotel's showstopper, offering two bedrooms, living and dining rooms, and an ample river-facing terrace. Caffè dell'Oro, the hotel's signature all-day restaurant, reopened in June 2025 after a full renovation with a new bar-centered design, under Executive Chef Luca Armellino — whose résumé includes Noma, Per Se (Thomas Keller), and St. Hubertus. The redesigned space positions the Ponte Vecchio as a constant backdrop. The hotel is a short walk from the Uffizi Gallery and Piazza della Signoria.

Description ⚙: Il Salviatino Firenze, an award-winning luxury hotel, is perched on the rolling hills of Fiesole, offering guests spectacular views of Florence. The unique accommodations range from Villa Rooms and Green House Suites to Signature Suites, each providing an inspiring vista of either the private park, the Tuscan landscape, or the iconic Duomo of Florence. The culinary experience revolves around the authentic Italian tradition, combining simplicity and refinement with ingredients sourced from the hotel's organic garden and local suppliers. The panoramic terrace provides sweeping views of Florence, creating a picturesque backdrop for every meal. The Sala Affresco offers an equally impressive experience, its walls resonating with the echoes of past gatherings. Guests have access to an outdoor heated pool with a view, a fitness center equipped by Technogym, a spa, free parking, and a shuttle bus service to Florence.

Description ⚙: The Brunelleschi Hotel in Florence is uniquely situated within a 6th-century Byzantine tower and a medieval church, standing out amongst Florence's many hotels for its blend of historical significance and modern luxury. The hotel is named after Renaissance Italian architect Filippo Brunelleschi, who designed the iconic dome of the Florence Cathedral. In recent years, the Brunelleschi Hotel has undergone extensive renovations including updates to the hotel facade, main glass staircase, and new suites. The hotel boasts 96 rooms, including 5 suites, each offering a unique view of the city. The deluxe rooms allow for romantic views of the Duomo; the deluxe panorama category features a round bed and full-circle Florence vistas of the Duomo, the Giotto Tower, Palazzo Vecchio, and beyond. The hotel's two restaurants offer distinct experiences: Santa Elisabetta, a two-Michelin-starred restaurant under Chef Rocco De Santis (confirmed 2024 Michelin Guide), is known for its intimate atmosphere in the Pagliazza Tower; Osteria della Pagliazza offers a more casual Tuscan dining experience. Both restaurants maintain an extensive wine cellar.

Winston Churchill was among the celebrated guests who spent time on these terraces. Description ⚙: The Ritz-Carlton, Guangzhou is located in the upscale Pearl River New City, next to the Guangdong Museum. The hotel offers 350 rooms and suites — some of which were subject to a recent refurbishment — and 91 high-grade apartments for extended stays. The Club Canton Tower River room category places Canton Tower and Pearl River in one frame with Club Lounge access included: private check-in, top-grade food presentations, and sweeping city vistas in one category. The outdoor heated pool is available year-round. Lai Heen, the hotel's Cantonese fine-dining restaurant, has held a Michelin star since the inaugural Guangzhou guide in 2018 and is among the most reserved tables in the city. The British-inspired Churchill Bar closes evenings with a single malt and city views.

Hotel Tagline: From 400 metres, the Pearl River fills the window wall with the IFC far below.
Summary: At 530 metres, this is the highest hotel in southern China. The Club River Rooms offer Pearl River views with the IFC below the window; the Manor Suites add private terraces. The TOO HIGH bar at 107 and the Asaya pool at 93 give the altitude somewhere to go.
Description ⚙: Set on the top 39 floors of the Guangzhou CTF Finance Centre — at 530 metres the tallest building in Guangzhou and the third-tallest in China — Rosewood Guangzhou is the highest 5-star hotel in southern China. The 251 rooms and suites, designed by Yabu Pushelberg with warm woods and royal blue lacquers referencing Lingnan architectural heritage, start on the 93rd floor. Club River Rooms face the Pearl River with a full window wall at over 400 metres; Manor Suites add private terraces over the city skyline. The Asaya Active wellness centre spans floors 93 and 94, housing a 25-metre indoor pool with river views, yoga studio, spa treatment suites, and fitness centre. Seven food and beverage venues include Lingnan House for classic Cantonese cuisine, Patina brasserie on the 95th floor, and the TOO HIGH sky bar and restaurant on the 107th floor with outdoor terraces and one of Guangzhou's most extensive whisky selections. The hotel opened in September 2019 and is listed in the MICHELIN Guide hotel selection.
Address: 6 Zhu Jiang Dong Lu, Tian He Qu, Guang Zhou Shi, Guang Dong Sheng, China, 510655
Nearest Airports: FOC · Foshan Shadi · 40 km; CAN · Baiyun · 44 km

Description ⚙: Park Hyatt Guangzhou occupies the upper floors of R&F Yingkai Square in Tianhe District, one of the most prominent towers in Zhujiang New Town. The Park Deluxe River View Suite occupies a corner position with the Pearl River in one direction and the Canton Tower lit at night in the other; the 25-metre indoor pool at cloud level frames the Canton Tower through its glass wall. Description ⚙: Conrad Guangzhou draws on the Xiguan Mansion — the historic merchant-class residences that defined Guangzhou's architectural heritage — for its interior design: carved details, layered materials, and a domestic warmth that distinguishes it from the glass-tower neighbours in Zhujiang New Town. South-facing upper floors frame the Pearl River and Canton Tower through full-height windows; the hotel terrace extends the river view for guests who prefer to take it outside. The indoor pool, sauna, steam room, and full-service spa provide a comprehensive wellness circuit. Three restaurants serve Chinese and international cuisine across the full day. Club Lounge access on premium room categories adds personalised check-in and dedicated food and beverage presentations throughout the stay.

Summary: The only luxury hotel in Guangzhou at river level: Haixinsha Island puts the Canton Tower directly across the water from the outdoor pool. Request a Canton Tower View Suite for the terrace sightline; by night, the LED display reflects across the Pearl River.
Description ⚙: Hotel Indigo Guangzhou Haixinsha occupies a position that no other luxury hotel in the city can replicate. Haixinsha Island — the green park island in the Pearl River that served as the stage for the 2010 Asian Games opening ceremony — places the hotel at river level, with the Canton Tower rising directly across the water from its outdoor pool and garden terrace. Where every other 5-star address in Guangzhou looks down at the river from a high floor, this one stands beside it. The 139 individually furnished rooms all include floor-to-ceiling windows; the Canton Tower View Suites add a private terrace with an unobstructed sightline to the tower. By night, the Canton Tower's LED display reflects across the Pearl River from the outdoor terrace. The SAIL restaurant serves Chinese cuisine across breakfast, lunch, and dinner. A poolside bar and cocktail terrace extend the river and tower view into the evening.

Description ⚙: Grand Hyatt Guangzhou occupies one of the most logistically central positions in Zhujiang New Town. The 368 rooms and 48 suites are fitted with floor-to-ceiling windows, and the Sky Lobby delivers the most comprehensive panoramic view of the full CBD available from any hotel space in the district: the Canton Tower, the Guangzhou International Finance Centre, and the CTF Finance Centre simultaneously in a single unobstructed frame. The Grand Club Lounge — accessible to premium room guests — provides personalised check-in, all-day food and beverage presentations, and dedicated service throughout the stay. Three restaurants serve international cuisine across the full day. O Spa provides a full treatment menu. An indoor pool and 24-hour gym complete the wellness facilities. The hotel is immediately adjacent to the Guangzhou Opera House, designed by Zaha Hadid and completed in 2010, and operates a complimentary shuttle to the Pazhou Exhibition Complex during Canton Fair periods.

Hotel Tagline: Perched on a bluff above Three Rocks Beach, with the Pacific breaking against rocks directly below.
Summary: The Ocean Front rooms sit above Three Rocks Beach on a bluff that drops straight to the Pacific — fire pit on the stone terrace, gas fireplace inside, and the Old Course running along the cliff edge below. Bagpipes at sunset are a daily ritual. The room to ask for is any Ocean Front category; suites add private terraces with unobstructed panoramas.
Description ⚙: Being the only Forbes Five-Star hotel in this Californian coastal city, The Ritz-Carlton, Half Moon Bay, presiding over Three Rocks Beach, holds its position as the defining oceanfront property on the Northern California coast. Waves crash against the rocks below while fog often drapes the property in a mystical morning haze, creating the kind of raw coastal beauty that draws visitors from San Francisco and around the world. A full property refresh completed in September 2024 carried through all 261 rooms and suites, introducing coastal textures and warm leather accents. Ocean-view rooms feature private fire pits on stone terraces; Ocean Front rooms and suites deliver unobstructed Pacific panoramas. The two championship golf courses wind along the bluffs, with the Old Course dating to 1973 and the Ocean Course playing along the cliff edge from holes 16 through 18. Dining at Navio — Forbes Four-Star and Michelin Recommended in 2025 — means 180-degree Pacific views through dramatic arched windows, with Chef de Cuisine Xisco Simon's sustainable tasting menus. The Conservatory serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner with floor-to-ceiling Pacific views. Nightly bagpipe performance at sunset.
Address: 1 Miramontes Point Rd, Half Moon Bay, CA 94019, USA
Nearest Airports: SQL · San Carlos · 33 km; SFO · San Francisco · 39 km; OAK · Oakland · 65 km; SJC · San Jose · 68 km

The Halekulani Suite, designed by Vera Wang, is 2,135 square feet with a wrap-around balcony. La Mer is Hawaii's only Forbes Five-Star restaurant, offering French cuisine with Hawaiian influences. House Without A Key is a beachfront bar known for sunset views. The iconic oceanfront pool features a mosaic orchid design created from 1.2 million South African glass mosaic tiles. Dining includes Sushi Sho, a 16-seat Edomae-style omakase counter by chef Keiji Nakazawa; Solera, focused on Hawaiian regional cuisine; Quiora, an open-air Italian concept; and Dean and DeLuca. The adults-only heated infinity pool is the highest in Waikiki. In 2023, the hotel received the Condé Nast Traveler Readers Choice Award as the best hotel in Hawaii.

The signature spa Nami Spa introduced traditional Japanese ofuro soaking baths to Oahu, alongside Himalayan salt saunas and cold plunge circuits. The hotel's design features tall columns, intricate woodwork, and a large banyan tree planted in 1904 that covers the courtyard. Summary: The only hotel that looks down at the Petronas Twin Towers. Between floors 97 and 114 of Merdeka 118 — the world’s second-tallest building — every room places the city’s icons below the horizon. The 99th-floor pool confirms it. Ask for a City View Room above floor 100.
Description ⚙: The only hotel in Kuala Lumpur from which the Petronas Twin Towers are visible from above. Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur occupies levels 97 to 114 of Merdeka 118 — the second-tallest building in the world at 678.9 metres — making it the highest hotel on the planet by occupied floors. Opened in August 2025, designed by GA Group (London), the 252 rooms and 27 suites all feature floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows. City View Rooms face the Petronas Twin Towers directly; Corner Suites frame the city on two sides. The indoor pool on the 99th floor positions swimmers above the Twin Towers, KL Tower, and the Exchange TRX. Merdeka Grill focuses on premium cuts and locally sourced produce; Cacao Mixology and Chocolate — the city's first chocolate-themed bar — serves cocktails framed by a panoramic view overlooking the Petronas Twin Towers from above.
View Subjects: Petronas Twin Towers, KL Tower (Menara KL)

Three dining venues — Lemon Garden (international buffet), Shang Palace (Cantonese), and Arthur's Bar and Grill (Manhattan-style steak bar) — make it a strong in-house dining destination. The outdoor pool is surrounded by the city's skyline; the spa and Health Club are among the most comprehensive at a Kuala Lumpur city hotel.

The Signature Ocean suites position breaking surf beneath the terrace; the pool deck brings you to the cliff edge. That sea-reflected light, shifting all day, is what the stay is actually built around.
Description ⚙: Montage Laguna Beach is a five-star resort set on 30 acres of coastal bluff above the Pacific Ocean in Laguna Beach, California. The property occupies a headland between Crystal Cove State Park and Main Beach, with ocean views from all guest rooms, suites, and three outdoor pools along the cliff edge. Direct beach access leads to a semi-private stretch of sand below the bluffs. The resort has 250 rooms, suites, bungalows, and villas. Three restaurants include Mosaic Bar & Grille and The Loft. The spa occupies 20,000 square feet. Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star property.
Address: 30801 Coast Hwy, Laguna Beach, CA 92651, USA

Description ⚙: Casa Loma Beach Hotel (formerly The Inn at Laguna Beach) is a 70-room clifftop boutique hotel opposite Heisler Park in North Laguna, positioned above the Pacific Coast Highway with unobstructed ocean views from all sea-facing rooms and suites. The hotel completed a $15 million renovation in Summer 2024, redesigning all guest rooms and public spaces. A rooftop terrace and pool overlook the Pacific. Main Beach and the village are a two-minute walk.
Address: 211 N Coast Hwy, Laguna Beach, CA 92651, USA
Nearest Airports: SNA · John Wayne · 25 km; LGB · Long Beach · 55 km

Description ⚙: The Ranch at Laguna Beach is a resort set in Aliso Canyon, 350 yards from the Pacific Ocean, with views of the canyon walls and surrounding hills from all rooms and the main pool. The property includes a nine-hole golf course, farm-to-table restaurant (The Harvest), full-service spa, and access to Aliso Beach via a pedestrian underpass beneath the Pacific Coast Highway. The canyon setting provides a contrasting view experience from Laguna's clifftop and beachfront hotels.
