Summary: The heated infinity pool puts Delos and Rineia Island directly across the strait. Worth staying for the Signature Spa Pool Suite: panoramic private pool, 55 sq m personal spa, outdoor hot tub, and the same Aegean sightline from every angle.
Description ⚙: In the spring of 2018, Mykonos welcomed a notable addition to its luxury hospitality scene with the opening of Mykonos Riviera Hotel & Spa. This upscale hotel quickly rose to prominence as one of the top accommodations on the island. Ideally situated moments away from Mykonos Town, Mykonos Riviera Hotel & Spa boasts one of the most spectacular views in Mykonos and is conveniently located near Tourlos Port, a gateway to the surrounding islands and their stunning beaches. The hotel is renowned for its breathtaking infinity heated pool, which seamlessly blends into the blue horizon of sea and sky. The 500-square-meter Oqua Spa offers a soothing pool environment and Thalasso treatments. The Signature 2 Bedroom Spa Pool Suite features a private 55-square-meter mini spa with sauna, steam bath, and fitness equipment, a panoramic private pool, and a heated outdoor hot tub.

Description ⚙: Situated on the southern shores at Elia Beach, Myconian Imperial offers some of the most breathtaking sea views on the island. The morning begins with a scenic breakfast served at the Meltemi restaurant; the Eros Veranda Bar, renowned for its romantic sunsets, provides an unforgettable backdrop for evenings. The finest room is the Executive Suite With Private Pool, with a private terrace and panoramic sea views. A significant advantage is access to a private section of the beautiful Elia Beach. The hotel boasts three swimming pools, inviting jacuzzis, and a glamorous in-house spa. A 15-minute drive from Mykonos Town.

Hotel Tagline: A 130-metre seawater pool holds the Aegean horizon, with Naxos beyond.
Summary: Perched on the quieter east coast above Kalafati, Cali runs the longest pool on the island — 130 metres of seawater flush against the horizon. The villas have private pools facing the same sea. The Missoni Resort Club debuted for 2025; the spa opened in 2024.
Description ⚙: An exclusive resort in Kalafati perched above a private beach on the eastern coast of Mykonos. Cali spans ten sun-drenched acres with 38 suites and villas, each offering a private sanctuary. A 130-meter infinity pool stretches toward the Aegean horizon, with Kalafati Beach below and Naxos visible on clear days. Three distinct dining options anchor the property. New for 2025, Cali unveils the Missoni Resort Club on the exclusive private beach. The spa, which opened in 2024, presents a complete wellness circuit with red-light therapy suites, a meditation room, sauna, steam room, and cold plunge suite. The Terra Athletic Club is an open-air Pilates and yoga facility with sea views.
Address: Mykonos 846 00, Greece

Description ⚙: Overlooking the deep blue waters of the Aegean Sea from its commanding position 100 metres above Elia Beach in Mykonos, the Myconian Utopia Resort is a member of Relais & Châteaux. Combining unspoiled nature with contemporary design, Utopia features 50 suites and villas, all with sea terraces and private pools. The Pavilion Relais & Châteaux restaurant offers Mediterranean cuisine at breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The thalassotherapy spa provides signature wellness treatments. A complimentary shuttle connects guests to Elia Beach and Mykonos Town.

Description ⚙: A boutique property in Mykonos with breathtaking views over Psarou Beach and the azure Aegean Sea. Guests can stroll to Psarou Beach and Platis Yalos Beach. The hotel features minimalist decor, saltwater swimming pools, and a cliffside breakfast terrace overlooking the bay. Accommodations cater to various needs, with the three-bedroom Coast Life Villa Suite particularly favored by families. The staff is known for exceptional care, and thoughtful touches such as a complimentary beach bag and farewell candle gift are standard.

Description ⚙: Bill & Coo Mykonos is an intimate boutique hotel with 30 rooms on Megali Ammos Beach, a short walk from Mykonos Town. Every room has a private terrace with sea views. The hotel's pool, lit with fiber optics at night, is one of the most photographed on the island. Restaurant Yēvo, under Executive Chef Aggelos Bakopoulos, earned Toques d'Or recognition in 2025 and is widely regarded as one of the finest dining establishments in Mykonos. The hotel also features a Valmont Spa — the only one on the island — and the sister property The Coast Bill & Coo provides additional beach access on Agios Ioannis.
Address: Bill & Coo Suites and Lounge Megali Ammos Beach, Μύκονος 846 00, Greece

Description ⚙: Deos opened in May 2024 above Mykonos Town, positioned at eye level with the Aegean horizon. The panorama extends from the 16th-century windmills and old harbour across to Delos and the neighbouring islands of Syros and Tinos. Every suite has a private terrace with either a plunge pool or hot tub. A complimentary golf buggy connects guests to Mykonos Town in under five minutes. The Epico restaurant serves market-fresh Mediterranean cuisine and welcomes outside reservations. The spa and a 24-hour gym are available to all guests.

Summary: On Agios Ioannis, Delos sits directly across the water, and the Althea Spa Retreat was positioned to face it deliberately. Sea-view rooms share that sightline; private pools throughout. Privileged access to Shirley Valentine’s beach adds to the argument.
Description ⚙: The Mykonos Grand Hotel & Resort enjoys an enviable location on Agios Ioannis beach, overlooking Delos Island and the azure Aegean Sea. The world-class beachfront hotel combines seclusion with convenience and offers a complimentary shuttle service to Mykonos Town. Rooms are elegantly appointed in traditional Cycladic architecture, with sea-view options and private pools available. Privileged access to Shirley Valentine's serviced beach is provided. The Althea Spa Retreat, named after a Greek goddess, faces the island of Delos — the mythological birthplace of Apollo, son of Zeus.

Description ⚙: The Surin Phuket occupies a prime beachfront position directly on Surin Beach, one of Phuket's most picturesque stretches of coast on the island's northwestern shore. The resort's low-rise cottages and suites are built steps from the sand, giving every room category an unobstructed sightline to the Andaman Sea. The Beach Cottages sit closest to the water, with private terraces level with the shoreline. Upper-tier categories include Pool Suites and the Terrace Suite, which adds a private plunge pool facing the sea. Surin Beach itself is one of the calmer bays on the west coast with good snorkeling conditions off the rocks at its southern end. The resort's beachfront Catch restaurant serves Thai and seafood dishes at the water's edge; the main infinity pool echoes the sea horizon.

Summary: One hundred metres above Kamala Bay, Paresa’s 36 villas each have a private pool on a stepped hillside with an unobstructed Andaman horizon. Worth staying for the Sky Bar at sunset — the angle from here is the widest view available at any Phuket hotel.
Description ⚙: Paresa Resort Phuket is built into a steep hillside approximately 100 metres above sea level on the cape separating Kamala Bay from the next headland north. The resort's 36 pool villas are arranged on terraced levels, each constructed so that the private infinity pool cantilevers over the jungle slope with a direct, unobstructed sightline to the Andaman Sea below. Description ⚙: The 130 suites at Rosewood Mayakoba are distributed across a 620-acre estate of Caribbean beachfront, freshwater lagoons, and managed mangrove in the Mayakoba enclave north of Playa del Carmen. Every suite includes a private plunge pool. The resort shares the Mayakoba estate with Banyan Tree, Fairmont, and Alila, and its bicycle trails connect guests to more than 30 restaurants across the four properties. The El Camaleón Golf Course, designed by Greg Norman and host to an annual PGA Tour event, runs through the estate.

Description ⚙: Palmaïa occupies the southernmost point of Playa del Carmen's Playacar zone, enclosed on three sides by 400 hectares of undisturbed tropical jungle and opening on the fourth to a private Caribbean beach. Every menu across the five à la carte restaurants is fully plant-based. The Atlantis Spa in the Jungle is anchored by a natural cenote and a traditional Mayan temazcal. Daily programming includes yoga, cacao ceremonies, sound baths, and guided meditation. The property is accessible only by golf cart through the adjacent resort — there is no direct road into Palmaïa.

Casa Amate, the signature Mexican and Latin American restaurant, sources from the estate's organic garden and regional producers; its Sunday brunch has earned a following within the enclave. Spa Alila frames its programme around the Mayan concept of Kuxtal — a return to vitality through nature. The Mayakoba bicycle trails connect all four hotels across the estate.

Description ⚙: The Riviera Maya EDITION at Kanai opened in December 2023 as the first EDITION hotel in Mexico, positioned within a 620-acre nature reserve ten miles north of Playa del Carmen's center. The 182 rooms and suites are housed in a low-rise structure that follows the natural contours of the reserve; the design brief — minimal environmental footprint, maximum integration with the mangrove and tropical flora — shapes the building's footprint and landscaping. Two miles of private Caribbean beach define the resort's eastern edge; a lagoon-sized main pool mirrors that scale on the landward side. All accommodations have direct access to a beach sightline or pool view. The resort's penthouse suite is the largest in North America.

The headline view belongs to Zlatá Praha, a fine dining restaurant on the hotel's upper floor with floor-to-ceiling windows surveying the panorama of Prague's Old Town, the spires of St. Vitus Cathedral, and the towers of the Charles Bridge in a single sweep. River View Rooms look directly across the Vltava to the opposite bank. The hotel is the only Fairmont property in this region of Europe to offer the Fairmont Gold programme, with dedicated floors and a private lounge.

The 8th-floor Powder Tower Suite offers a panoramic view of Prague Castle that represents the pinnacle of the property's view offerings. The hotel's Steiner's Restaurant serves Bohemian and international cuisine in an elegant atmosphere.

Description ⚙: Declared a historical monument in 1984, the five-star Hotel Paris Prague is a timeless gem built in the early 1900s, radiating elegance at every turn. This family-run luxury hotel, nestled in the heart of Old Town, transports guests to a decadent, jazz-infused era of carefree sophistication. Every detail adds to its undeniable splendor, from the grand marble staircase and Art Nouveau design to the captivating artwork and breathtaking views of Old Town. The spacious guest rooms are embellished with Art Nouveau-style furniture and tasteful art. For the most breathtaking panoramas, the Mucha Suite, a bright top-floor accommodation, brings Prague Castle so close guests feel they can reach out and touch it.

The luxurious guest rooms, each a nod to Prague's 'Golden City,' boast views of the city's most iconic landmarks including the Powder Tower and St. Henry's Tower from upper floors. Description ⚙: W Prague opened in November 2024 on the iconic Wenceslas Square, reviving the Art Nouveau Grand Hotel Evropa, which had defined this square since 1906. The transformation layers bold contemporary interiors over the protected heritage structure without compromising its ornate facade, coffered ceilings, or original stained glass. Throughout 161 rooms and suites, the design draws on Czech artist Alphonse Mucha's aesthetic and Prague's nickname as the City of Gold. The flagship WOW Bohemia Duplex Suite on the 8th floor bridges the heritage wing and contemporary extension. Above Rooftop, a seasonal outdoor terrace, delivers a panoramic view of Prague's historic skyline—the spires of St. Vitus Cathedral, towers of the Old Town, and the rooftop of a city built to be seen from above.

A stone's throw from Prague Castle, Charles Bridge, and the cobblestoned streets of the Little Quarter, the property is one of Prague's most intimate five-star boutique hotels.

Description ⚙: No list of boutique hotels in Prague is complete without mentioning the extraordinary The Mozart Prague. This Old Town luxury hotel has earned a stellar reputation thanks to its attentive staff, prime location, and breathtaking views of Prague's iconic landmarks including Prague Castle and Charles Bridge. Legend has it that Mozart himself stayed here and composed some of his works. The spacious guest rooms and vacation homes are each individually designed and lavishly appointed. For those seeking the ultimate experience, the River View Suite offers unmatched panoramas of Prague Castle, Charles Bridge, and the Vltava River from the soft pinks of sunrise to the golden reds of sunset.

The rooftop bar at sunset, when the illuminated castle rises above the water, provides the most cinematic view in New Town.

The Tower Room on the sixth floor offers the highest vantage point on the hill, giving the sensation of having Salzburg at one's feet. The Apollo Suite is the largest accommodation and features a Calacatta marble bathroom with a scenic freestanding bathtub. The hotel dedicates 300 sqm to the Mönchstein Spa with a full menu of massages, sauna, and gym facilities. A seasonal outdoor infinity pool overlooks the city. The Glass Garden restaurant, holding a Michelin star (2025) and four Gault Millau toques, serves under a distinctive glass dome with panoramic views of the Old Town. Located on Makartplatz between Mirabell Palace and the Festival Houses, the hotel offers views over Salzburg Cathedral from various vantage points and select private balconies. The Deluxe Suite is the hotel's crown jewel, featuring a private terrace with direct views of the Fortress Hohensalzburg and Salzburg Cathedral domes. The historic building showcases an antiqued style with original artworks, paintings, and collectibles throughout. The Polo Lounge restaurant serves Austrian and international specialities for lunch and dinner. The Sketch Bar & Lounge provides cocktails and wines by the fire. Valet parking and concierge service are available.

The hotel's 70 rooms and suites include the seventh-floor Sky Suites (ETAGE7), which feature private balconies with direct views of the Fortress Hohensalzburg and the beautifully maintained Mirabell Gardens. Guests in ETAGE7 Sky Suites enjoy privileged access to the ETAGE7 Rooftop Lounge, which offers captivating city panoramas. The hotel's Restaurant Mirabell serves Austrian gastronomy overlooking the park gardens. The Piano Bar provides live music and cocktails. The fitness centre offers a sauna, steam bath, and massages on request. The hotel holds Green Key certification for sustainability practices and is within walking distance of the Old Town, Mozart's Birthplace, and Festspielhaus.

The rococo palace dates from 1736 and served as a filming location for The Sound of Music. Worth a stay for the morning view alone.
Description ⚙: Hotel Schloss Leopoldskron is a rococo palace built in 1736, set on the shore of the Leopoldskroner Weiher lake on the southern outskirts of Salzburg. Previously owned by theatre director Max Reinhardt, co-founder of the Salzburg Festival, the palace reopened as a hotel in February 2014 and is a member of Historic Hotels of Europe. The hotel is also celebrated as a filming location for The Sound of Music (1965). Rooms and suites in the historic palace building and in the adjacent Meierhof building offer views over the formal gardens, the lake, and the Austrian Alps, with the Fortress Hohensalzburg visible on the ridge above the city. The hotel's panoramic balcony and lake-facing rooms provide morning views across the water toward the mountain scenery. A substantial breakfast is served in the palace dining hall. The hotel also serves as a venue for the Salzburg Global Seminar.
Address: Leopoldskronstraße 56/58, 5020 Salzburg, Austria

The Sky Bar is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with the evening atmosphere particularly celebrated for romantic city views as the Old Town lights up at dusk. The Tower Suite on the fifth floor reproduces the same fortress-and-cathedral sightline from a private residential setting. The hotel's flagship asset is the Steinterrasse, a rooftop bar and restaurant open year-round on the seventh floor, offering a panoramic view of Fortress Hohensalzburg, Salzburg Cathedral, St. Peter's Abbey, the Kollegienkirche, the Salzach River, and the Untersberg massif — all in the same frame. In winter, the snow-capped Untersberg provides a dramatic backdrop behind the fortress. The Honeymoon Suite on the second floor features Barovier & Toso artworks and captivating Old Town views from its windows. The hotel is steps from Linzer Gasse, a lively street of boutiques and cafés, and within easy walking distance of the Mozart Residence and Mirabell Palace. The hotel is directly adjacent to Salzburg Hauptbahnhof train station, providing direct rail links to Munich, Linz, and Vienna. The property is within a 10-minute walk of Mirabell Palace.

Beach Village villas spread the same horizon from private terraces with full kitchens.
Description ⚙: Hotel del Coronado, Curio Collection by Hilton is a National Historic Landmark established in 1888 on Coronado Beach, designated a California Historic Landmark in 1970 and a National Historic Landmark in 1977. It is the second largest wooden structure in the United States. The hotel completed a six-year, $550 million revitalization in 2025, including the full restoration of the Victorian building and its guest rooms, the renovation of Beach Village, and the addition of Shore House. Ocean-view rooms in the Victorian building face the Pacific directly. Beach Village offers oceanfront cottages and villas with private terraces, full kitchens, and fireside verandas. Dining includes Nobu Del Coronado and Veranda, an al fresco restaurant with Pacific views.
Address: 1500 Orange Ave, Coronado, CA 92118, USA

Vistal, the hotel's rooftop bar and restaurant, keeps the bay panorama at table level throughout the evening. Garibaldi serves regional California cuisine at street level. The wellness centre features bay views integrated into the training floor and an outdoor yoga terrace facing the water. The hotel is 1.6 kilometres from the USS Midway Museum and four minutes from the International Cruise Ship Terminals.

The Golden Gate-View Corner Suite on the upper floors is the room to ask for — windows wide enough to hold the bridge end to end, with Alcatraz filling the eastern edge.
Description ⚙: The Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco at Embarcadero, formerly the Mandarin Oriental and Loews Regency Hotel, is San Francisco's tallest hotel at 48 floors above street level in the Financial District at 222 Sansome Street. Following an extensive renovation completed in 2022, the hotel delivers panoramic views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge, San Francisco Bay, Transamerica Pyramid, Coit Tower, Salesforce Tower, and Alcatraz. The Golden Gate-View Corner Suite on the upper floors frames the bridge end to end through expansive windows, with Alcatraz to the east. The Golden Gate Terrace Suite at 1,200 square feet is the hotel's flagship accommodation. The hotel is a short walk from the Moscone Center and central to the Financial District.

Description ⚙: Cavallo Point occupies the former military facilities at Fort Baker within the Golden Gate National Recreation Area in Sausalito, less than one mile from the north anchorage of the Golden Gate Bridge. It is the nearest hotel to the bridge. The historic rooms at a slightly lower elevation still deliver iconic views of the bridge, while the contemporary rooms — particularly the westernmost — allow guests to see the full structure from panoramic balconies. The property includes a Healing Arts Center and Spa offering holistic therapies, and on-site programming including cooking classes and scenic picnics. The adjacent Bay Area Discovery Museum is within walking distance.

Description ⚙: The St. Regis San Francisco is a 5-star hotel in a 40-story architectural landmark in SoMa designed by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, opening in 2005. All 260 rooms and suites were renovated under Toronto-based Chapi Chapo Design, completed in 2020, with a subsequent lobby and bar refresh in 2022 led by London-based Blacksheep. The hotel offers commanding skyline views over San Francisco from its elevated position in the Yerba Buena cultural corridor, one block from the Moscone Center. The top-floor Presidential Suite spans 3,200 square feet with full cityscape views. The corner Metropolitan Suite and the Astor Suite — which includes the brand's Signature Butler Service — are the recommended rooms for the view. A heated infinity pool faces the San Francisco skyline. The ground floor of the building houses the Museum of the African Diaspora (MoAD), and SFMOMA is steps away.
Address: St. Regis Museum Tower, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA
Nearest Airports: SFO · San Francisco · 22 km; OAK · Oakland · 33 km

Its ethos of environmental sustainability extends from supply chain to a rooftop chef's garden and on-site beehives that supply the Terrene restaurant. The seven Panoramic Waterfront suites face east toward the Bay Bridge and offer sunrise views of the structure from the water's edge. The Terrene patio provides al fresco dining with direct views of the Bay Bridge and Ferry Building clock tower; fire pits extend its use into the cooler evenings. Executive Chef Eric Marting leads the restaurant's farm-to-table programme, sourcing ingredients within 100 miles.

Description ⚙: The Fairmont San Francisco is a Beaux Arts landmark on Nob Hill, originally built in 1906 and rebuilt after the post-earthquake fire, reopening in 1907. Its 606 rooms and suites are distributed across the main building and the taller adjacent tower. In the main building, views improve significantly from the third floor upward; the sixth-floor Main Building Balcony Suite has an unobstructed view of the Transamerica Pyramid. The tower building delivers the strongest panoramas: the 23rd-floor Signature Golden Gate suite is equipped with binoculars and faces the Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge, San Francisco Bay, Transamerica Pyramid, Coit Tower, Salesforce Tower, and Alcatraz. The hotel is associated with Tony Bennett, who is said to have performed 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco' for the first time in its ballroom.

Hotel Tagline: Golden Gate, Alcatraz, and the bay — framed from the 19th floor since 1939.
Summary: Top of the Mark has been framing San Francisco since 1939 — the 19th-floor sky lounge that turned panoramic views into a city institution. Golden Gate, Alcatraz, the bay: all visible from a room that shows its age, and remains, for that very reason, one of the addresses the city keeps coming back to.
Description ⚙: The InterContinental Mark Hopkins San Francisco, an IHG Hotel, is a historic luxury property at the crest of Nob Hill, opened in December 1926 on the site of the former Victorian mansion of railway magnate Mark Hopkins. The hotel has 383 rooms including 33 suites, and sits at the crossing of three cable car lines. Its defining feature is Top of the Mark, the 19th-floor sky lounge opened in 1939 — San Francisco's original penthouse cocktail lounge, known as the city's favourite penthouse cocktail lounge for over 80 years. The lounge delivers 360-degree panoramic views including partial views of the Golden Gate Bridge to the west, Alcatraz and San Francisco Bay to the north, the Marin Headlands, and the full city skyline. Top of the Mark was rated No. 1 Best Hotel Bar in California and San Francisco by USA Today's 10 Best, and No. 2 in the nation. The hotel's 100 Martinis menu and Saturday evening live entertainment are longstanding traditions. Guest rooms on upper floors offer skyline and bay views. The Nob Hill Club provides on-site dining. In December 2026, the property will mark its centennial year. The hotel has been voted among the Best 5 Hotels in San Francisco by Travel + Leisure.

Summary: Mission Bay’s first hotel opened in December 2022 with floor-to-ceiling bay and skyline views across most of its 299 rooms. The Cavaña rooftop on the 17th floor — fire pits, Bay Bridge, Oracle Park below — makes the case for the neighbourhood most San Francisco hotels still haven’t discovered.
Description ⚙: LUMA Hotel San Francisco is the first hotel built in Mission Bay, opening in December 2022. Designed by Cole Martinez Curtis & Associates with an exterior by Hornberger + Worstell, the 17-floor property earned LEED Silver certification. Its 299 rooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows with motorized shades, with Premier rooms offering panoramic views of either the San Francisco skyline or San Francisco Bay. A 16th-floor penthouse suite includes a soaking tub and wet bar. The 17th-floor Cavaña rooftop bar and lounge has a wraparound patio with fire pit seating and confirmed views of the Bay Bridge, the city skyline, and Oracle Park directly below. The hotel is adjacent to Chase Center (Golden State Warriors) and Oracle Park (San Francisco Giants), with access to the Central Subway. Public spaces feature commissioned art installations by San Francisco artists Jim Campbell and Adia Millett. AperiBar operates at lobby level.

Description ⚙: The Clift Royal Sonesta San Francisco is a historic hotel originally built in 1915 for the Panama-Pacific International Exposition. The hotel completed a full renovation designed by Gensler in January 2020 and fully reopened in 2021 following a pandemic closure. All 372 guestrooms and suites were updated to a neutral handcrafted aesthetic. City-view rooms and suites offer San Francisco skyline vistas including the Salesforce Tower; the One-Bedroom suite is the recommended room for the view. Dining and drinking venues include Fredericks, a breakfast and café eatery named for original owner Frederick C. Clift, and the restored Art Deco Redwood Room — a San Francisco institution with original redwood panelling and a bar manufactured from an 800-year-old redwood tree. The hotel is one block from Union Square and near the Curran Theatre.

Description ⚙: The Fairmont Heritage Place Ghirardelli Square is a five-star all-suite hotel in a former chocolate factory founded by Domingo Ghirardelli, a landmark red-brick building in Ghirardelli Square recognisable by its historic Ghirardelli sign. The bay-front location delivers views of the Golden Gate Bridge to the left and Alcatraz Island directly ahead. The One-Bedroom Residence and the Signature Three-Bedroom Bay View Residence offer expansive vistas of San Francisco Bay with romantic fireplaces in all living rooms. The hotel is particularly suited to longer stays by the nature of its all-suite configuration. Description ⚙: A city like São Paulo surely deserves a rooftop panoramic pool with extensive views of its ever-expanding skyline. With this and other thoughts in mind, the visionary team behind the luxury hospitality label Fasano came up in May 2023 with one of the most exciting hotel openings in the city in recent years: the exceptional Hotel Fasano São Paulo Itaim. As the name hints, this lavishly appointed property is located in one of São Paulo's most desirable areas, Itaim-Bibi, where the city strikes the right balance of fashionable shops, hip restaurants, and executives going about their lives following a loose, smart-casual dress code. The landscaped, heated rooftop pool offers the finest viewpoint of the city within the hotel, which includes the affluent Jardins area and countless high-rise buildings. Under the close watch of a team combining acclaimed architect Marcio Kogan and aflalo/gasperini studio, this five-star real estate project, the brand's second in the city, soon evolved into one of the best hotels in São Paulo.

Description ⚙: Mention the words hotel, view, and rooftop to any Paulista, and chances are you'll hear an instant reply with Hotel Unique. Consistently praised as one of the best hotels in São Paulo, the hotel name perfectly matches what guests expect from their stay: unconventional architecture, an unparalleled rooftop bar and pool, and second-to-none skyline vistas. When the hotel debuted in São Paulo's luxury hospitality scene, it was received with mixed reactions — some compared it to a watermelon slice, others to an oddly shaped submarine. Despite the lack of consensus, the urban landscape of the posh Jardins area had changed forever, thanks to the late Ruy Othake, one of Brazil's most respected modernist architects, who came up with the concept of a red pool that instantly became one of the hotel's stand-out features. Of the 80 rooms and 12 suites, the 7th-floor Oasis Suite takes the prize for the best quarters in the house — sweeping city vistas through circular windows and a private terrace with a small red jacuzzi.

Description ⚙: Does your idea of a luxurious hotel stay in São Paulo involve a panoramic bathtub facing the city's most iconic bridge, the Ponte Estaiada Octavio Frias de Oliveira? If so, we are glad to introduce you to the Grand Hyatt São Paulo, regarded as one of the best five-star hotels in São Paulo. Contemporary, spacious, and elegant rooms with ample windows feature modern technology and soothing beige and white tones. All suites facing the bridge are considered the hotel's most premium accommodations; among these, the Diplomatic Suite, ideally placed on the building's corner and featuring separate dining and living rooms, rewards guests with the finest cityscape views. This property faces the Pinheiros River, and the hotel collects the preferences of executive travelers attending meetings in Berrini, the neighboring WTC, or the many large corporate events on its premises. For guests wishing to balance their stay with leisure, the hotel offers an outdoor swimming pool, an excellent spa with an indoor pool, and a generous 24/7 fitness room.

Description ⚙: Brazil's first W Hotel made its São Paulo debut in December 2024, occupying the upper half of a glass tower designed by local firm aflalo/gasperini arquitetos in Vila Olímpia. The hotel's 179 rooms and 16 suites all begin from the 25th floor, ensuring uninterrupted views of São Paulo's skyline and the Pinheiros River below. Interior design by Portuguese designer Nini Andrade Silva draws on Brazilian modernist references — bold colors, rich textures, and curated local elements. The 40th floor hosts the hotel's twin centrepieces: the WET Deck, an infinity-edge outdoor pool with a 360-degree sweep of the skyline, and L40 Cozinha de Latitude, a restaurant merging Brazilian produce with the culinary traditions of regions along the same parallel. The AWAY Spa occupies the 39th floor with three treatment rooms, while the FIT gym features floor-to-ceiling windows framing the São Paulo skyline during every workout.

Description ⚙: Tivoli Mofarrej São Paulo is an iconic luxury hotel that has become the preferred residence for visiting heads of state and international celebrities, including Mick Jagger and Lady Gaga, who famously used the hotel's 22nd-floor Presidential Suite — dubbed as Latin America's largest — as the backdrop for a music video. All 218 rooms and suites reflect the hotel's commitment to luxury, with generous layouts and elegant design. It only takes booking a 21st-floor Deluxe Room City View to sleep next to stunning panoramic views of São Paulo. Among the upscale highlights is Seen, a rooftop restaurant on the 23rd and top floor, offering the opportunity to sample sushi next to jaw-dropping urban vistas — visiting at night and witnessing the scintillating skyline from above is particularly rewarding. The Anantara Spa and the circular outdoor pool, unshadowed between the high-rises, provide a peaceful retreat from the city's hustle and bustle.

Description ⚙: The Fasano Group's first hotel, Hotel Fasano São Paulo, opened in 2003 in the charming homonymous Vitório Fasano street, only steps away from the happening Oscar Freire. To this day, the five-star hotel still occupies a noteworthy position in the best São Paulo hotels list. With core values such as Italian-inspired elegance, timeless design, warm wood tones, and high hospitality standards, the hotel instantly became a reference in São Paulo's luxury hotel scene. Visionary founder Rogério Fasano — whose personal nickname gave rise to the Gero restaurant brand — brought together architects Isay Weinfeld and Marcio Kogan, whose work laid the foundation for the Fasano brand's expansion. Guests occupying the higher-floor rooms and suites — the spacious Suite Deluxe is a good example — enjoy perfect views of the Jardins neighbourhood and the cityscape. The hotel's top-floor indoor pool, sheltered by stone walls, unveils four large windows that beautifully frame the affluent Jardins neighborhood and the São Paulo skyline.

The hotel's 258 rooms and suites are spread across the first 14 floors; for the most impressive views, the higher accommodations — including a stunning Presidential Suite and the Deluxe High Floor and Premium with Bathtub categories — reveal iconic panoramas of the Estaiada Bridge and the Pinheiros River from north-facing units. Description ⚙: When staying at the aristocratic Palácio Tangará, the postcard image of a São Paulo filled with thousands of high-rise buildings couldn't be more disconnected from the truth. This grand six-story neoclassical hotel of 141 rooms and 59 suites rivals São Paulo's best. The soothing view here is towards Parque Burle Marx, a public 11-hectare green space with an Atlantic rainforest, lush lawns, towering palm trees, and iconic landscaping — available from all accommodations. As one feels immersed in this nature-surrounded property, it is almost hard to believe that one of the world's busiest cities is only minutes away. The Palácio Tangará's top-grade amenities set it apart, including a 20-meter outdoor pool, a 25-meter heated indoor pool, a fitness center, and a Sisley spa. Exceptional food is another reason to stay at this exclusive address, with the Michelin-starred Tangará Jean-Georges restaurant having been recognised with multiple awards.

Hotel Tagline: Boynton Canyon wraps around on all sides — no room faces away from the red rock walls.
Summary: Boynton Canyon wraps around the resort on all sides — no room faces away from the red rock walls. Book a casita with a kiva fireplace and a private deck that puts the canyon at arm’s length. At sunset, the table at Che Ah Chi more than earns its reputation.
Description ⚙: Enchantment Resort is a 218-room luxury resort nestled entirely within Boynton Canyon, one of Sedona's most celebrated red rock formations, located at 525 Boynton Canyon Road, Sedona, AZ 86336. Every casita, suite, and private pool suite opens onto a private deck or patio directly overlooking the canyon walls. Accommodation ranges from casitas adorned with kiva fireplaces to one- and two-bedroom suites and private pool suites with scenic canyon views. The resort's on-site dining includes Che Ah Chi, a panoramic restaurant serving modern American cuisine with Southwest influence at breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and Tii Gavo, a casual gathering-place restaurant open each evening with canyon terrace seating. A new 9,300-square-foot pool deck with custom cabanas and poolside restaurant The Edge was completed in June 2024. Across the road, Mii amo is a Forbes Five-Star destination spa offering wellness programs and guided activities. The resort provides over 100 weekly activities including wine tasting, tennis, golf at nearby Seven Canyons, guided hikes to Subway Cave and the Boynton Pass Vortex, and meditation sessions. Named among Travel + Leisure's top destination resorts.
Address: 525 Boynton Canyon Rd, Sedona, AZ 86336, USA
Nearest Airports: FLG · Flagstaff Pulliam · 55 km

Hotel Tagline: From creekside cottages on Oak Creek to Vista Cottages facing Snoopy Rock, Giants Thumb, and Elephant Rock.
Summary: The choice at L’Auberge is between water and rock: creekside cottages sit directly on Oak Creek; Vista Cottages face Snoopy Rock, Giants Thumb, and Elephant Rock. Cress on Oak Creek — French technique, Verde Valley ingredients — makes a strong case for staying put.
Description ⚙: L'Auberge De Sedona is a five-star luxury resort and member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World, situated on the banks of Oak Creek in Uptown Sedona, Arizona, at 301 L'Auberge Lane, Sedona, AZ 86336. Owned by DiamondRock Hospitality Company and managed by Aimbridge Hospitality, the property totals 158 guestrooms following the addition of The Cliffs, a newly reimagined wing developed through the acquisition and enhancement of the former Orchards Inn. The property offers a choice between creekside cottages set directly on Oak Creek, Vista Cottages with direct views of Snoopy Rock, Giants Thumb, and Elephant Rock, and The Cliffs rooms with sweeping red rock panoramas and modern design. Accommodation categories include cottages with cedar outdoor showers, fireplaces, and private patios, lodge rooms, The Cliffs suites, and the five-bedroom Creekhouse private sanctuary. Signature restaurant Cress on Oak Creek serves French-influenced Arizonan cuisine using local Verde Valley ingredients; it received Wine Spectator's 2025 Award of Excellence. L'Apothecary Spa underwent a significant expansion in 2024, adding a garden relaxation area, three new treatment rooms, and a dedicated wet room. The Spirit Song Terrace hilltop viewpoint offers panoramic red rock views and serves as a popular wedding venue. The resort is adjacent to Munds Wagon Trail and Marg's Draw Trail.
Address: 301 L'Auberge Ln, Sedona, AZ 86336, USA
Nearest Airports: FLG · Flagstaff Pulliam · 42 km

Summary: The rooms face Thunder Mountain across West Sedona, but the Rangeview Rooftop is where the view earns its name. Evenings at the Grove Gardens fire pits — the sky darkening behind the rock formations — are what guests come back to describe most after a stay.
Description ⚙: The Wilde Resort and Spa is a four-star boutique resort in West Sedona, Arizona, at 2250 West Highway 89A, Sedona, AZ 86336, formerly known as Sedona Rouge Hotel and Spa before its 2021 rebrand and renovation. The 105-room property features rooms and suites with views of Thunder Mountain and the surrounding red rock formations. The Rangeview Rooftop is the resort's signature view point, offering panoramic sightlines over the West Sedona landscape at sunset. The Grove Gardens fire pit area is a nightly gathering space beneath the open sky. The Wilde Haven Spa is a 5,000-square-foot full-service spa with outdoor hot tubs, body treatments, facials, massages, and wellness sessions incorporating crystal alchemy and local healing traditions. The resort is located near the Sugar Loaf and Soldier's Pass trails and within driving distance of Boynton Canyon. On-site restaurant Rascal serves American cuisine with Southwest influences.
Address: 2250 W State Rte 89A, Sedona, AZ 86336, USA
Nearest Airports: FLG · Flagstaff Pulliam · 45 km

Summary: The infinity pool sits on the bank of Oak Creek with Snoopy Rock filling the horizon — that view is the resort’s centrepiece. Rooms have balconies facing the same formation. At SaltRock Southwest Kitchen, the patio puts the Cleopatra Red Rock Formation front and center.
Description ⚙: Amara Resort & Spa is a four-star boutique resort in Uptown Sedona, Arizona, at 100 Amara Lane, Sedona, AZ 86336, set on the banks of Oak Creek with panoramic views of Snoopy Rock and the Cleopatra Red Rock Formation. The resort completed a multimillion-dollar renovation in 2021, designed by Mendil + Meyer Design Studio, introducing a tree-lodge aesthetic across all 100 guestrooms and public spaces. Every guestroom includes a balcony overlooking the red rocks or the garden courtyard. The signature zero-edge infinity pool is positioned at the edge of Oak Creek, directly facing Snoopy Rock. The on-site SaltRock Southwest Kitchen restaurant features Southwestern-inspired cuisine with Verde Valley-sourced ingredients and an expansive patio with red rock views; its renovated interior includes Himalayan salt accent walls and a live-edge community dining table. The full-service Amara Spa includes a 24-hour fitness center. Consistently named among Condé Nast Traveler's Best Hotels and U.S. News & World Report's Best Hotels.
Address: 100 Amara Ln #101, Sedona, AZ 86336, USA
Nearest Airports: FLG · Flagstaff Pulliam · 41 km

Summary: Perched on Airport Mesa, 500 feet above town, Sky Ranch Lodge has been framing Snoopy Rock and the Red Rocks since 1982. The outdoor area reads more like a viewing platform than a hotel patio — one guests are reluctant to leave when the evening light hits the rock.
Description ⚙: Sky Ranch Lodge is a historic property situated on Airport Mesa in Sedona, Arizona, at 1105 Airport Road, Sedona, AZ 86336, 500 feet above the town, offering panoramic 360-degree views of Snoopy Rock and the surrounding Red Rock formations. The lodge dates to 1982 and has been a consistent destination for guests seeking elevated red rock vistas. The outdoor area, including the wine patio and viewpoint, has served as the setting for numerous weddings and events. The property features a saltwater heated outdoor pool, room balconies, and a wine patio overlooking the Red Rocks. The lodge is certified as a botanical garden, with manicured ponds and specimen trees, and holds a sustainability certification. A hiking trail circumnavigating Airport Mesa is accessible from the property and offers uninterrupted eagle-eye views of Sedona's rock formations.
Address: 1105 Airport Rd, Sedona, AZ 86336, USA
Nearest Airports: FLG · Flagstaff Pulliam · 45 km

Description ⚙: Matterhorn Inn is a four-star hotel in Uptown Sedona, Arizona, at 230 Apple Avenue, Sedona, AZ 86336, offering guaranteed red rock views from every room. Every guest room includes a private balcony or terrace directly facing Oak Creek Canyon and the surrounding red rock formations. Renovated in 2020, the property is dog-friendly and located within walking distance of Uptown Sedona's art galleries, restaurants, wineries, cafés, and shops. The hotel features an outdoor pool during warmer months and well-designed two-bedroom suites with full mountain panoramas that represent one of the strongest view-for-value propositions in the market. Families are particularly well served by the suite configuration.

Description ⚙: Arabella Hotel Sedona is a three-star boutique resort in Sedona, Arizona, at 725 Highway 179, Sedona, AZ 86336, set on eight acres of high-desert landscape on Gallery Row. Trailhead rooms offer extra space and patios with partial Red Rock views of Snoopy Rock. The hotel's back gate provides direct access to Marg's Draw trail, a beginner-friendly hiking route leading to Snoopy Rock. The on-grounds Sunset Vista overlook delivers one of the most expansive panoramas in the area. The property features family-friendly outdoor pools, a fitness center, fire pits, complimentary cruiser bicycles, EV charging facilities, and a large dog park. Complimentary hot breakfast is served daily. The hotel is within walking distance of the Tlaquepaque Arts and Shopping Village and Hillside Sedona galleries.

Description ⚙: Hilton Sedona Resort at Bell Rock is a four-star resort in the Village of Oak Creek, Sedona, Arizona, at 90 Ridge Trail Drive, Sedona, AZ 86351, set directly opposite the Bell Rock vortex site. All 221 rooms and suites feature a romantic fireplace, a private balcony or patio, and views of the surrounding red rock formations; the most sought-after rooms face Bell Rock directly. The resort completed a multimillion-dollar renovation in 2024. Facilities include the year-round heated Cascades Family Pool, a 25-meter heated adult lap pool, a full-service eforea Spa, lighted pickleball and tennis courts, and 25,000 square feet of fitness and wellness amenities. The Gary Panks-designed 18-hole Sedona Golf Resort is adjacent to the property. On-site dining includes ShadowRock Tap + Table, the resort's signature restaurant with a fireside patio, and the seasonal Blue Water Café by the pool. Pink Jeep Adventure Tours concierge is available in the lobby.

The hotel's view-facing balcony rooms represent one of the strongest value propositions for red rock views in the Uptown area. The property includes indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a children's playground, and sports facilities. Guests have direct access to Oak Creek and the adjacent Sedona Arts Center. The Tlaquepaque Village arts and shopping centre is within walking distance. Complimentary breakfast is included.

Hotel Tagline: From the 76th floor up, Han River and Seoul's mountains spread across the full skyline.
Summary: Between floors 76 and 101 of Lotte World Tower, the panorama here is total: Han River, the full Seoul skyline, and mountains on clear mornings. The room to request is any suite facing west — at this altitude, city lights at night are a different category of hotel view.
Description ⚙: Imagine staying in one of Korea's tallest buildings with a view of the Han River, Seoul's skyline, and mountains. That's precisely what you'll get when booking into the exclusive Signiel Seoul, a prestigious hotel in Seoul that sits between the 76th and 101st floors of the sky-scraping Lotte World Tower in Jamsil-dong. In this complex, guests will find a selection of restaurants, a mall, a folk museum, and even an aquarium — and all this while being surrounded by the beautiful Songpa Naru Park or Seokchonhosu Lake, the ideal place for a lakeside morning jog. Savoring refined flavors at the onsite French Restaurant STAY and discovering Korean cuisine at BICENA — holder of a Michelin star for nine consecutive years — are among the indulgences available at this five-star hotel. The afternoon tea is served at The Lounge, while patrons can enjoy a selection of liquors and spirits with an incredible 81st-floor sky view at Bar 81.
Address: 300 Olympic-ro, Songpa District, Seoul, South Korea
Nearest Airports: GMP · Gimpo · ~28 km

Located near the Gyeongbokgung Palace and Cheonggyecheon Stream, this five-star hotel in Jongno-gu caters to just about everything one needs for a comfortable and luxurious stay. The elegant rooms and suites reward guests with panoramic vistas, especially those over the Gyeongbokgung Palace from the Palace-View Executive Suites. The signature breakfast buffet is a magnificent spread, and the onsite dining is spectacular, with cuisines ranging from Cantonese to Japanese, Korean, and Italian.

The hotel has 550 rooms and suites, with top-floor units offering the most rewarding sightlines over the Seoul skyline. Connected directly to the upscale Parnas Mall, ensuring guests easy access to global fashion brands and eateries. Located in the heart of Gangnam near the COEX convention complex.

Nearest Airports: GMP · Gimpo · ~24 km

Premier River rooms above the 12th floor feature floor-to-ceiling windows with unobstructed Han River views. The Bamseom Suite adds Namsan Tower to the frame with a private outdoor terrace. The 20th-floor infinity pool faces the Han River directly, while Restaurant Voisin on the 22nd floor serves French cuisine with the same panorama. Mapo Station on Subway Line 5 is a five-minute walk.

All 185 rooms share the same panoramic logic; the Park Suite or any corner suite captures Teheran-ro on two sides. Samseong Station is a one-minute walk.
Description ⚙: The Park Hyatt Seoul rises over Teheran-ro — Gangnam's financial spine — as a 24-floor glass-and-stone tower where the reception and lobby sit on the uppermost floors. Each of the 185 rooms and suites faces the city through floor-to-ceiling windows. The Lounge on the 24th floor serves modern Korean cuisine with panoramic city views. The Timber House runs a premium whisky and cocktail program with live music nightly. The 23rd-floor spa and 17-meter heated indoor pool deliver city views while swimming. Samseong Station on Line 2 is less than a one-minute walk.

The view combines the Han River with the ancient Bongeunsa Temple directly below — a rare juxtaposition in Gangnam. Corner suites carry the same sightline.
Description ⚙: The Westin Seoul Parnas reopened in September 2025 after a complete renovation of a building that operated as a landmark Gangnam hotel for 25 years. Under Marriott International and Parnas Hotel, the rebuilt 30-floor property runs 564 rooms along a wellness-centered brief. The Westin Club Lounge on the 30th floor — Korea's largest hotel club space at 702 square meters — delivers panoramic views of the Han River and Bongeunsa Temple directly below. The Cosmopolitan Fitness Club on the third floor includes a pool, sauna, yoga studio, and golf simulators. Connected directly to COEX Mall and the COEX Convention Center.

Nearest Airports: GMP · Gimpo · ~24 km

Description ⚙: The Shilla Seoul, the first luxury hotel in Seoul and one of the most iconic hotels in the city, was awarded the title of the first five-star hotel in South Korea by Forbes in 2019. The hotel harbors an exceptional spa overlooking the lush landscape of Mount Namsan — Asia's first Guerlain Spa — an inner golf court, a state-of-the-art gym, a beautiful garden, a high-end mall, and six eateries. With Mount Namsan and N Seoul Tower as the backdrop, Urban Island on the third floor is an idyllic wellness oasis. A free shuttle bus connects guests to the city.

The Executive Tower hosts Pierre Gagnaire à Seoul on the 35th floor — a Michelin-recognized contemporary French restaurant. Additional dining options include Korean at Mugunghwa, Japanese at Momoyama, Chinese at Toh Lim, and an international buffet at La Seine. La Maestría restaurant serves traditional Andalusian cuisine, including oxtail stew and gazpacho; Bar La Maestría specialises in the city's finest Sherry wines.

Hotel Tagline: From the 98th floor, the Oriental Pearl Tower sits below eye level against the full sweep of the Huangpu River.
Summary: Opened in June 2021, J Hotel occupies floors 86 to 98 of China’s tallest building — the Pearl Tower sits below. The Shanghai Suite on the 98th floor delivers the definitive read. Above: Heavenly Jin on the 120th floor, the highest restaurant in any building in the world.
Description ⚙: J Hotel Shanghai Tower opened in June 2021 on the topmost hotel floors of the Shanghai Tower, China's tallest building and the second-tallest in the world at 632 meters. Rooms and suites occupy floors 86 through 98, placing the hotel in a category of its own: at these altitudes, the Oriental Pearl Tower, the Jin Mao Tower, and the Shanghai World Financial Center are all visible at or below eye level, and the full sweep of Pudong's skyline unfolds with the Huangpu River and the Bund beyond. Every one of the 165 rooms and 34 suites has floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows and personal butler service included around the clock. The Shanghai Suite on the 98th floor is the hotel's signature accommodation — 380 square meters of curved parlor, bedroom, dressing room, study, and physiotherapy area, with an exclusive panoramic view of Shanghai. Seven restaurants and bars are distributed across multiple floors. Heavenly Jin on the 120th floor, 556 meters above ground, is the highest restaurant within a building in the world. Jin Yan on the 103rd floor specializes in Cantonese cuisine; Kinnjyou Inaka on the 104th floor offers kaiseki and teppanyaki. Centouno on the 101st floor brings Mediterranean cuisine to a dining room by Italian artist Edoardo Tresoldi. The Yi Lounge on the 84th floor is the hotel's bar and live jazz venue. The Reiki Spa and a 160-meter skyline swimming pool occupy floors 84 and 85.
View Subjects: Oriental Pearl Tower, Huangpu River, Pudong Skyline

Description ⚙: Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai opened in 2018 on the banks of Suzhou Creek in Jing'an, occupying the top eight floors of a 48-story tower — floors 41 through 48 — with Bund and Pudong skyline views that differ from any hotel on the eastern bank. The 82 rooms and 19 suites all have floor-to-ceiling windows. The Bvlgari Suite extends to 400 square meters with a direct view over the Huangpu River; Premium Bund View rooms are positioned for simultaneous sightlines to the historic waterfront and the Oriental Pearl Tower. The building was designed by ACPV Architects — Antonio Citterio and Patricia Viel — and connects at ground level to the restored Shanghai Chamber of Commerce, originally completed in 1916. Il Ristorante – Niko Romito on the 47th floor received a Michelin star in the 2024 Michelin Guide Shanghai. The Bvlgari Bar shares the 47th floor and offers a panoramic view of the Bund riverfront and Pudong skyline. The Bvlgari Spa extends across 2,000 square meters with an indoor pool, hammam, and sauna. Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai was included in the Conde Nast Traveler Gold List in 2020 and is listed in the MICHELIN Guide.
View Subjects: The Bund, Pudong Skyline, Oriental Pearl Tower

Description ⚙: The Peninsula Shanghai, a glamorous luxury hotel on the Bund, offers breathtaking views of Shanghai's skyline and the Huangpu River. The hotel is beside the historic former British Consulate and is praised for its panoramic scenes of Pudong landmarks across the river, including the Oriental Pearl Tower, Jin Mao Tower, and Shanghai Tower. Sir Elly's Restaurant, Bar, and Terrace serves contemporary French dishes, and its rooftop terrace provides some of the city's most scenic skyline views. Yi Long Court, a Cantonese restaurant with a Michelin star in the 2024 Michelin Guide Shanghai, combines traditional Chinese techniques with modern flair. Designed by New York's BBG and French designer Pierre-Yves Rochon, guest rooms reflect Art Deco elegance. Spacious rooms feature large windows with city or river views. Summary: Every room delivers Bund views, but the framing depends on the floor. The Shanghai John Jacob Astor Suite eliminates all ambiguity — panoramic Bund and Pudong sightlines from a hotel that opened in October 2024 and set a high benchmark for the southern Bund corridor immediately.
Description ⚙: The St. Regis on the Bund, Shanghai opened in October 2024 following acquisition and repositioning of the property. The hotel offers 192 rooms and suites along the historic Bund with staggering views of the Huangpu River, the futuristic Pudong skyline, and Shanghai's most famous landmarks. Set along the historic Bund and a short drive to Nanjing Road, this hotel features Art Deco-inspired interiors integrating architecture from different cultures. The 192 rooms range from 45 to 288 square yards; certain units have Bund views while others provide upgraded Panoramic Bund views. The Shanghai John Jacob Astor Suite offers unambiguous panoramic sightlines over the Bund and Pudong. St. Regis Butler Service is standard across all room categories.

Hotel Tagline: From the fifth to seventh floors, the Oriental Pearl Tower and Pudong skyline rise across the Huangpu River.
Summary: The Nine Nations Suites, floors five through seven, share the same Bund and Pearl Tower panorama — seen from a hotel whose pyramidal green roof has marked the skyline since 1929. Worth staying for the Sunday tea dance and the Old Jazz Band as much as for the view.
Description ⚙: Fairmont Peace Hotel on the Bund, with its iconic green pyramidal roof, has graced Shanghai's skyline since 1929, embodying an unmatched charisma and elegance. English actor Charlie Chaplin once favored this historic riverside address as his Shanghai hotel of choice (then the Cathay Hotel). The hotel has hosted presidential speeches, inspired acclaimed novels, and served as a filming location for Steven Spielberg's Empire of the Sun. The Cathay Room serves modern French cuisine, and Dragon Phoenix is a Shanghainese restaurant. The Nine Nations Suites, located between the fifth and seventh floors, reflect nine different countries' styles while sharing a magnificent river and skyline vista. The hotel features 270 guestrooms including 39 suites, the Willow Stream Spa with 11 treatment rooms, and a private sky-lit swimming pool. The Sunday tea dance and nightly Old Jazz Band performances are among the hotel's cultural traditions.

Summary: The infinity pool on the 41st floor, jade-tiled and set against the full Lujiazui skyline, is the most photogenic reason to book. The Pearl Tower is the anchor; the two-bedroom Pearl River View Suite on the 37th and 38th floors keeps it in frame around the clock.
Description ⚙: Regent Shanghai Pudong stands in the 21st Century Tower at the heart of Lujiazui, surrounded by three of the city's most recognizable supertall buildings. The hotel's Art Deco-inspired rooms are finished in cream and chocolate tones with accents of China red, all with floor-to-ceiling windows delivering Pearl Tower and Lujiazui skyline views. Marble bathrooms feature deep-soaking tubs, separate rain showers, and twin gold-inlaid vanities. The two-bedroom Pearl River View Suite occupies the 37th and 38th floors with clear sightlines to the Pearl Tower. The three-bedroom Pearl View Presidential Suite extends to 432 square meters. Shang-Xi, the hotel's Cantonese restaurant, seats 22 in its main hall and offers five private dining rooms named after precious gemstones. Camelia serves authentic Italian cuisine with indoor and outdoor seating. FLARE Spa occupies the 41st floor alongside a jade-tiled infinity-edge pool and hot tub with panoramic views of Shanghai's financial district and the Pearl Tower. Regent Shanghai Pudong is recommended by the MICHELIN Guide.

Hotel Tagline: From the 87th floor, the Bund and Pearl Tower sit level with the clouds below.
Summary: The Jin Mao Tower has been part of Pudong’s skyline since 1999. Cloud 9 on the 87th floor still holds the views; rooms on the 70th floor and above frame the Pearl Tower and the Bund at close range. The 33-story hotel atrium spiraling below is a view unto itself.
Description ⚙: Grand Hyatt Shanghai crowns the Jin Mao Tower — the 88-story pagoda-inspired landmark that has defined Pudong's skyline since the building opened in 1999 — occupying floors 53 through 87 of the 420.5-meter structure. The hotel's most dramatic architectural feature is its 33-story barrel-vaulted atrium beginning on the 56th floor, a 27-meter-wide void that spirals 115 meters upward to the building's crown. The 548 rooms and suites are distributed across 18 different room styles, all with floor-to-ceiling windows and views of the Bund, the Pearl Tower, and the Huangpu River. Canton on the 55th floor occupies the full level and serves traditional Cantonese cuisine. Club Jin Mao on the 86th floor delivers Shanghainese cuisine with panoramic views. Cloud 9 on the 87th floor is the hotel's sky bar, voted by Forbes as one of the world's best bars in 2000. The ON56 collection on the 56th floor encompasses Kobachi (Japanese), Cucina (Italian), and The Grill (seafood and prime meats). The Club Oasis Spa and Sky Pool occupy the 57th floor.

Description ⚙: Located at No. 2 on the Bund, the Waldorf Astoria Shanghai on the Bund offers guests breathtaking views of the Huangpu River and the Pudong skyline, with iconic landmarks such as the Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai Tower, and Jin Mao Tower. The hotel spans two buildings: the historic Astoria Club, which preserves original features from its days as the exclusive Shanghai Club, and the Astoria Tower, with 240 exquisitely appointed rooms looking onto Sichuan Road and 20 top-notch suites overlooking the Bund. The Bund-facing Suite 304 is the most direct view room. Wai King Kok serves exquisite Shanghainese, Cantonese, and Huaiyang specialties. The Grand Brasserie provides a mix of Asian-inspired and European dishes for all-day dining. The Long Bar — a historic space once famous for being the longest bar in the Far East at 34 meters — invites guests to enjoy classic cocktails in a timeless ambiance reminiscent of old Shanghai.

Summary: FLAIR on the 58th floor has one of the city’s most dramatic bar views — the Pearl Tower fills the window and the Bund sits across the river. We’d time a dinner at Jin Xuan on the 53rd floor, Michelin one-star for nine consecutive years, and pair it with a Premier Bund View Suite.
Description ⚙: The Ritz-Carlton Shanghai, Pudong is a luxurious escape set atop a 58-story tower in the heart of the financial district, allowing for omnipresent views of Shanghai's skyline, the Huangpu River, the Oriental Pearl Tower, and the Bund on the opposite shore. Every detail captures the elegance of the Art Deco era, from the rich wood and chrome accents in the lobby to the refined cream and mahogany tones in the rooms and suites, each featuring floor-to-ceiling windows and marble bathrooms with signature gold accents. The Premier Bund View Suite grants access to the Club Lounge and delivers jaw-dropping vistas of the Oriental Pearl Tower and the Bund. FLAIR on the 58th floor serves Asian-inspired dishes and handcrafted cocktails alongside dramatic views. The Michelin-starred Jin Xuan — which has held a one-star rating for nine consecutive years as of the 2026 Michelin Guide — occupies the 53rd floor and specializes in refined Cantonese cuisine. Scena Di Angelo, helmed by Michelin-starred chef Angelo Aglieno, offers Mediterranean fare. The Water's Edge Spa on the 55th floor features ten treatment rooms and a heated indoor pool.

Description ⚙: The Mandarin Oriental Pudong, Shanghai opened on the east bank of the Huangpu River in Lujiazui and quickly became a benchmark for modern luxury. The hotel resembles a museum showcasing over 4,000 artworks, half by Chinese artists, including Miao Tong's 20-meter-high The Sound of Heaven mosaic in the lobby. The 362 rooms and suites, designed by Bernardo Fort-Brescia, span over 50 square meters and feature panoramic views, premium furnishings, and Frette linens. The Premier River View Suite creates a portrait combining the Oriental Pearl Tower and the sinuous river. Dining options include Fifty 8 Degree Grill (modern French), Yong Yi Ting (Michelin-starred Cantonese, 2024 Michelin Guide Shanghai), the Mandarin Cake Shop, and Qi Bar. The hotel features a 2,415-square-meter spa and a 25-meter indoor pool. Wellness facilities include sunset yoga sessions and Fusion Fitness lessons.

Description ⚙: The Park Hyatt Shanghai, set atop the Shanghai World Financial Center, occupies the 79th through 93rd floors and delivers unmatched panoramas of the Huangpu River, the Bund, the twisted Shanghai Tower, and the Oriental Pearl Tower from every room. The 173 rooms and suites, designed by Tony Chi and Associates, combine minimalist luxury with floor-to-ceiling windows and marble bathrooms. The 100 Century Avenue restaurant on the 91st floor serves prime beef, market-fresh seafood, and premium poultry against floor-to-ceiling windows framing the full skyline. The Dining Room on the 87th floor specializes in Chinese cuisine. The 86th-floor Park Salon offers complimentary champagne and panoramic views in select rates. The Bund View Suite is the most requested accommodation. The Water's Edge Spa and 24-hour fitness center serve the hotel's mid-floors. The infinity pool on the 85th floor offers the sensation of swimming above the Lujiazui skyline.

Description ⚙: Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh is the only property in the region with a private funicular connecting the clifftop grounds to the beach. The resort's 197 rooms and suites all include a private balcony or terrace; upper floors command an unobstructed panorama across the gulf to Tiran Island. Ten al fresco dining venues face the water, including Zitouni (Lebanese) and Yatai (Asian). A PADI dive centre operates from the beach with access to one of the region's best-rated house reefs. The spa offers 12 treatment rooms including two outdoor cabanas facing the Red Sea.

A lagoon-style outdoor pool flanks the private coral beach, and a private jetty gives direct snorkelling access to the house reef.

Description ⚙: Park Regency Sharm El Sheikh Resort — formerly Hyatt Regency Sharm El Sheikh prior to December 2020 — occupies three private beach coves at Gardens Bay. Every room in the 421-key inventory comes with a furnished sea-view balcony as standard: no garden-view or pool-view tier exists. Outdoor dining terraces at all five restaurants sit above the Red Sea, which from here faces south toward Ras Mohammed National Park. Five outdoor pools, three private beaches, and a Club Olympus fitness centre with squash and tennis courts are supplemented by a spa.

Description ⚙: Meraki Resort is an adults-only boutique property on the Red Sea beachfront at El-Salam, 1.2 km from Sharm International Airport. The design logic is visible the moment you enter the room: all-white interiors, sculptural gold-and-white coral-pattern headboards, pendant lighting, and then floor-to-ceiling windows with nothing between you and the sea. The outdoor pool sits at beach level with direct access to the private shore and reef. The restaurant serves Greek, Italian, seafood, and international cuisines. The property operates exclusively all-inclusive for adults (18+).

Hotel Tagline: From the Ping An Finance Centre's upper floors, Shenzhen spreads 270 degrees in every direction.
Summary: The Sky View Deluxe rooms frame 270 degrees of Shenzhen from the Ping An Finance Centre’s upper floors — and guests with time to spare can ascend to the 116th-floor Free Sky observation deck. The Attic bar, a floor above The Glasshouse restaurant, is the right place to end the evening.
Description ⚙:
The Park Hyatt Shenzhen commands attention from its position in the striking Ping An Finance Centre, one of the world's tallest buildings (after its completion in 2017). The luxurious hotel occupies floors 36 to 44, offering guests an extraordinary vantage point over Shenzhen's dynamic cityscape. Enjoying the most astonishing vistas in Shenzhen is as effortless as it gets for guests staying at this property: taking the lift to the Free Sky observation deck on the 116th floor is enough to do the trick.

From this elevated sanctuary, guests can marvel at sweeping views of Shenzhen's ever-evolving skyline through vast floor-to-ceiling windows that define public spaces and accommodations. The view takes on different personalities throughout the day — from crisp morning vistas over the city awakening to the dramatic display of urban lights at nightfall.

The hotel's design aesthetic merges contemporary luxury with subtle cultural touches, creating sophisticated spaces that feel both global and distinctly Chinese. The 171 rooms and 24 suites are private retreats in the sky, each featuring architectural windows that frame the metropolitan panorama below. The 300-square-meter Presidential Suite is the crown jewel, featuring double-height windows and a separate living room offering a spectacular 180-degree cityscape panorama. With almost the same exceptional vistas, the Sky View Deluxe rooms are also a fabulous option.

Unsurprisingly, food, drinks, and vistas always seem to be close. Starting the night with a drink at The Attic bar followed by a meal at The Glasshouse or the Garden Pavilion is the recipe for a long-lasting memory. The Living Room transforms throughout the day from a breakfast venue to an elegant dinner destination, particularly striking at sunset.

On the 8th floor, the fitness center and 25-meter swimming pool continue the hotel's theme of elevated luxury with city views. The spa offers treatments that blend Asian and modern therapeutic techniques, featuring traditional Chinese massage among its signature offerings.

The hotel's location in the Futian District places guests in a prime position near the Convention and Exhibition Center. They have easy access to high-end shopping and the convenient Shenzhen Metro system.
Address: 5023 Yi Tian Lu, 中心城 Fu Tian Qu, Shen Zhen Shi, China, 518046

Hotel Tagline: From the 66th floor and above, Shenzhen Bay opens south toward the Hong Kong ridgeline.
Summary: South-facing rooms above the 66th floor open onto Shenzhen Bay and the Hong Kong ridgeline — a sightline unavailable from any other hotel in the city. The 77th-floor Wellness Club, at over 300 meters, adds a gym with a 180-degree bay panorama worth factoring into the booking decision.
Description ⚙:
Shangri-La Nanshan, Shenzhen opened in 2024 within the Shenzhen Bay Super Headquarters Base, Nanshan's most ambitious new coastal district. The hotel occupies floors 66 to 78 of a supertall at Shenwan Huiyun Center — a building whose geometry was conceived to evoke homing birds spreading their wings toward the water. The metaphor is apt: from the south-facing rooms, Shenzhen Bay leads the eye directly to the hills of Hong Kong's New Territories, visible on clear days as a pale ridgeline across the strait. It is a view angle that no other hotel in the city shares.

The 272 rooms and suites, all beginning above the 66th floor, are oriented around four distinct sightlines. South-facing rooms hold the most coveted position, with floor-to-ceiling windows framing Shenzhen Bay and Hong Kong in a single unobstructed arc. North-facing rooms look toward the OCT Mangrove Ecological Park, one of Shenzhen's protected wetland reserves. East-facing rooms take in the Overseas Chinese Town waterfront; west-facing rooms survey the Shahe Golf Course greens far below. Room categories with wraparound corner windows compress all of this into a single panorama.

On the 77th floor, the Wellness Club houses a gym that guests have described as one of the best-equipped in Shenzhen — elevated to over 300 meters, with a 180-degree bay panorama as the backdrop to every session. The full-service spa and indoor swimming pool share the same floor, both offering unobstructed views of the city spreading toward the coast.

The hotel's four dining venues span Cantonese and international cuisines, with an all-day dining restaurant and a dedicated Chinese restaurant serving as the two anchor options.

Connectivity is one of the Nanshan's quiet strengths. The hotel is directly connected to the RAIL IN shopping mall and sits within walking distance of Hongshuwan Station (Metro Line 2) and Hongshuwan South Station (Lines 9 and 11) — three lines that provide direct access to Futian, Luohu, and Nanshan's technology campuses. Shenzhen Bay Port, the ferry crossing to Hong Kong, is a 15-minute drive. Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport is 35 minutes away.
Address: Block J, Phase 5, Shenwan, Huiyun Center, Nan Shan Qu, Shen Zhen Shi, Guang Dong Sheng, China, 518000
Nearest Airports: SZX · Bao'an · 31 km

Hotel Tagline: From the 67th floor up, Lotus Hill sits to the north while Shenzhen Bay opens south toward Hong Kong.
Summary: A Michelin Key hotel since 2025, with a bar ranked among Asia’s 50 best — the case for staying still comes down to the rooms. The SHANG XIA-furnished Oriental Suite wraps its living areas in floor-to-ceiling glass: Lotus Hill to the north, Shenzhen Bay and Hong Kong to the south.
Description ⚙:
The Mandarin Oriental, Shenzhen, one of the best hotels in this fast-paced Chinese city, soars above the vibrant Futian district, occupying the upper floors (67th to 79th) of an architectural masterpiece in the heart of China's technology hub. The hotel's elevated position delivers breathtaking panoramic views — to the north, guests can trace the undulating outline of Lotus Hill (Lianhuashan Park), while the south-facing rooms offer a stunning vista of Hong Kong's New Territories across Shenzhen Bay.

Each of the 178 rooms and suites features floor-to-ceiling windows that frame spectacular city and mountain views. The interior design artfully blends contemporary luxury with subtle Chinese motifs. Starting at 56 square meters, even the entry-level rooms rank among the most spacious in Shenzhen. The hotel's crown jewel is its collection of specialty suites, particularly the SHANG XIA-furnished Oriental Suite, which offers separate living and dining areas surrounded by wraparound windows, creating an infinity-edge sensation high above the city.

For dining, the property hosts several distinctive restaurants, including The Bay by Chef Fei for refined Cantonese cuisine, the French brasserie OPUS 388, and RIN for Japanese Teppanyaki, all offering those same spectacular views that have become synonymous with the property. In 2025, the Mandarin Oriental, Shenzhen became one of the first hotels in mainland China to receive a Michelin Key. The MO Bar, on the 79th floor, was simultaneously ranked No. 21 on Asia's 50 Best Bars List — a dual distinction that cements the property as a destination well beyond accommodation.

The wellness facilities are on the 68th floor. They feature a 20-meter indoor swimming pool with floor-to-ceiling windows and a fitness center where guests can work out while gazing across the cityscape. The spa combines traditional Chinese healing philosophies with contemporary techniques.

On the 78th floor, The Mandarin Club is a destination on its own. Apart from displaying vistas that stretch as far as Hong Kong, it takes guests to cloud nine with exclusive services like private check-in and check-out, state-of-the-art meeting rooms, and culinary offerings that will make it hard to leave.

Location-wise, the five-star hotel is ideally positioned within the Futian business district, connected to premium shopping at UpperHills Mall, and within walking distance of the Futian high-speed railway station, offering easy access to Hong Kong.
Address: Block A UpperHills No, 5001 Huang Gang Lu, Fu Tian Qu, Shen Zhen Shi, Guang Dong Sheng, China, 518026

Summary: Premier rooms on the south side face Hong Kong across the border — a quiet geographical fact most guests don’t expect to find in Futian. Floor-to-ceiling windows throughout; corner suites give Lianhuashan Park its full width, with the city converging behind it.
Description ⚙:
Rising gracefully above Shenzhen's futuristic cityscape in the heart of Futian District, the Four Seasons Hotel Shenzhen embodies the spirit of this innovative metropolis. Inside, floor-to-ceiling windows throughout the luxury property capture sweeping views of a contrasting skyline with the lush greenery of Lianhuashan Park.

The elegant and comfortable rooms and suites serve as refined urban retreats, offering expansive views. The design emphasizes clean lines and natural light, with premium touches like marble bathrooms and advanced technology seamlessly integrated throughout. Premier rooms face south towards Hong Kong, while others offer views of the city center or Lianhuashan Park.

This particular hotel is also a family-friendly address: apart from pools that ensure fun moments, the little ones become over the moon with suites with tents and colored linens, as well as hidden surprises for kids throughout the stay.

Located in Futian's central business district, the Four Seasons Hotel Shenzhen provides convenient access to the Convention and Exhibition Center, high-end shopping destinations, and public transportation links to Hong Kong.

Summary: The panoramic bathtub is a standard fixture across most room categories here — positioned to face the skyline and the green line of Lianhua Mountain at once. Worth staying on Club Level for five daily food presentations; the Ritz-Carlton Suite adds a two-floor private entrance.
Description ⚙:
The Ritz-Carlton, Shenzhen, is a luxury hotel located in the heart of Futian District, Shenzhen's central business hub, directly opposite the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center. It offers panoramic views of the city skyline and Lianhua Mountain from a 28-floor building that has anchored this stretch of Futian since 2007.

One thing the 239 rooms and 41 suites share is space (this is a Ritz-Carlton property, after all), so one doesn't even need to book the extravagant Ritz-Carlton Suite to feel at ease. Elegance and luxury are also standard for all accommodations, such as fluffy blankets and, in most cases, a panoramic bathtub facing the Shenzhen skyline and the soothing sight of a park.

The hotel's wellness facilities include a landscaped outdoor pool, fitness center, yoga studio, and a full-service spa on the 6th floor. Add to the mix a convenient location, with easy access to the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center, high-end shopping, and public transportation, and you'll soon realize why this is one of the best hotels in Shenzhen.

Hotel Tagline: From the top floors of Kingkey 100, Shenzhen's skyline stretches south toward Hong Kong.
Summary: The top 25 floors of the Kingkey 100 building give the St. Regis a sightline that extends south toward Hong Kong. Ask for a Skyline room to get Bang & Olufsen audio paired with the city from above the clouds; the Iridium Spa on the 75th floor extends the altitude further.
Description ⚙:
Rising majestically above Shenzhen's effervescent Luohu District, The St. Regis Shenzhen, the brainchild of architect Terry Farrell, occupies the top 25 floors of the iconic Kingkey 100 building, one of the tallest skyscrapers in the city. This extraordinary location allows for sweeping panoramic views across Shenzhen, from the urban skyline to the scenic backdrop of the nearby mountains and even extending south toward Hong Kong, the bustling metropolis only 30 kilometers away from the city.

The fabulous 290 rooms and suites, impeccably designed by CCD/Cheng Chung Design studio, provide luxurious comfort. Expansive windows frame these stunning vistas for guests' joy, especially when personal playlists echo through the Bang & Olufsen sound systems in place. The interiors blend contemporary elegance with refined touches, including spacious marble bathrooms, advanced in-room technology, and custom furnishings.

For dining, guests can have a break from Chinese cuisine and sample Italian delicacies at the on-site Elba Restaurant; however, this time, Shenzhen's skyline has replaced the Tyrrhenian Sea vistas.

Guests looking for wellness and relaxation will find the hotel's Iridium Spa on the 75th floor, which features tailored treatments, a serene ambiance, and inspiring views. The 28-meter indoor swimming pool, particularly at night, provides the illusion of merging with the city's supertall skyscrapers.
Address: 5016 Shen Nan Dong Lu, Luo Hu Qu, Shen Zhen Shi, Guang Dong Sheng, China, 518001
Nearest Airports: SZX · Bao'an · 41 km

The QĪN restaurant provides city views paired with contemporary Asian cuisine. Guests access cultural programming including sessions with local artisans.

Description ⚙: Raffles Singapore, a designated national monument, is a 19th-century colonial landmark classified as one of Singapore's finest addresses. Following a meticulous three-year renovation, the hotel reopened in 2019 with 115 all-suite accommodations. Views overlook lush tropical gardens and traveller's palms, with suites featuring private terraces above the hotel's courtyard. The 3rd-floor outdoor pool adds broader city views. Dining spans the Long Bar, home of the Singapore Sling, the Writers Bar, Yì By Jereme Leung, and the North Indian Tiffin Room.

Description ⚙: Designed by the local WOHA architecture studio, PARKROYAL COLLECTION Pickering, Singapore is an eco-friendly hotel adjacent to Chinatown, featuring 15,000 square metres of rainwater-irrigated sky gardens terraced across the building's exterior.
